name: Beast Form
description: You can become any Beast of the Beasts of the Reikland section of the Bestiary.

name: T'Essla's Arc
description: Deal magic missile Damage +10 and inflict 1 Blinded Condition.

name: Fool's Gold
description: Turn any metal into gold.

name: Banishment
description: Affects all creature whose Toughness is lower than your Willpower. All creatures with Undead or Daemonic Traits gain Unstable Trait. If they already had Unstable Trait, their Wounds are reduced to 0.

name: Blinding Light
description: Emit blinding bright light. Everyone who is looking at you and does not have Arcane Magic (Light) Talent, receives +SL Blinded Conditions.

name: Conserve
description: Preserve day's worth of food rations. While preserved the rations cannot go bad.

name: Eavesdrop
description: You can clearly hear what the target is saying.

name: Magic Shield
description: Add +WP Bonus SL to any dispelling you do.

name: Ward
description: Gain Ward (9+) Creature Trait.

name: Earthblood
description: You have to be in direct contact with earth. All creatures with direct contact with earth in the affected area heal your WP Bonus Wounds at the start of every Round.

name: Drain
description: Drain target's life. Deal damage that counts as magic missile with +0 Damage and then Heal 1 Wound.

name: Twitch
description: Cause a small object to move. If the object is currently being held, the holder must pass an Average (+20) Dexterity Test or they will drop it.

name: Blast
description: Create a blast that counts as magic missile (Damage +3) that applies to everyone in the affected area.

name: Dark Vision
description: You gain the Dark Vision Creature Trait.

name: Distracting
description: You  gain the Distracting Creature Trait.

name: Cauterise
description: Heal 1d10 Wounds and remove all Bleeding Conditions. If the target does not have Arcane Magic - Fire Talent, they must pass a Challenging(+0) Cool Test or scream in agony. If they fail by 6 SL, they gain Unconscious Condition and are permanently scarred.

name: Crown of Flame
description: Gain Fear (1) Trait, +1 War Leader Talent and +10 on all attempts to Channel and Cast  Aqshy. For each +2 SL you can increase Fear by +1 or take extra level of War Leader Talent.

name: Lie of the Land
description: After communicating with the earth for 1 minute you know a detailed layout of the land and all natural features within range. Each time you increase the range with Overcasting, increase communication time by 1 minute.

name: Mindslip
description: While the spell lasts, the target loses all memories that involve you. Once the spell is over, the target has to pass an Average (+20) Intelligence Test or the memory loss becomes permanent (can be dispelled though).

name: Curse of Crippling Pain
description: Stab a puppet to cause harm to a target. Type of harm depends on the stabbed body part.

name: Manifest Lesser Daemon
description: Summon a Lesser Daemon. If you win Opposed Channel - Dhar/Willpower you respond to your one command and vanish. If you lose the Test, it will attack you.

name: Reanimate
description: Reanimate WP Bonus + SL dead bodies as Zombies or Skeletons. For each +2 SL, you may raise extra WP Bonus + SL creatures.

name: Careful Step
description: -30 penalty to Track Tests for anyone trying to track you in rural area.

name: Gust
description: Create a gust of wind strong enough to blow a candle or slam an open door.

name: Light
description: Create a small light (brightness of a torch) in your hand. If you pass an Average (+20) Channelling Test, the light can be adjusted to be of candle or lantern intensity.

name: Murmured Whisper
description: Your voice originates from a point within Willpower yards rather than from you.

name: Warning
description: Detect if the object is poisoned or trapped.

name: Breath
description: Make a Breath attack (as if you spent 2 Advantage to activate the Breath Creature Trait). Breath attack count as magic missile (Damage +T Bonus).

name: Terrifying
description: Gain Terror (1) Creature Trait.

name: Flock of Doom
description: Summons a flock of local birds. The birds attack everyone who does not have Arcane Magic - Beasts Talent by inflicting +7 Damage at the end of every round. Everyone within affected area gains +1 Blinded Condition. After passing an Average (+20) Charm Animal you can move the flock within the range.

name: Regenerate
description: Target gains the Regenerate Creature Trait.

name: Clarity of Thought
description: While the spell is active target ignores all negative mental modifies - from any source.

name: Dazzle
description: Target gain 1 Blinded Condition, and 1 Blinded Condition at the start of each Round for as long as the spell lasts.

name: Marsh Lights
description: Create a number (up to your Int Bonus) of small flickering lights. After passing an Average (+20) Channelling Test you can send the lights moving in any direction.

name: Bolt
description: Bolt is a magic missile (Damage +4).

name: Chain Attack
description: Magic missile (Damage +4). If it reduces Wounds to 0, it jumps to another target within spell's initial range and within Willpower Bonus yards of the previous target.

name: Dome
description: Everyone inside the dome gains Ward (6+) Creature Trait.

name: Flight
description: Gain Flight (Agility) Creature Trait.

name: Hunter's Hide
description: Gain +20 T, Dark Vision and Fear (1) Creature Traits, and Acute Sense - Smell Talent.

name: Flaming Hearts
description: Affected targets gain +1 Drilled, Fearless, and Stout-hearted Talents. They also lose all Broken and Fatigued Conditions.

name: Fate's Fickle Fingers
description: Pool Fortune Points with everyone that has Arcane Magic (Heavens) Talent. After the spell ends, remaining Fortune Points are redistributed as fairly as possible.

name: Enchant Weapon
description: Enchanted weapon counts as Magical, gains +WP Bonus to damage, and Unbreakable Quality. For every +3 SL you can add 1 Quality of remove 1 Flaw from the weapon.

name: Mutable Metal
description: After passing an Average (+20) Strength Test you can bend non-magical object made of metal.

name: Pha's Protection
description: Creates protective barrier against creatures with Daemonic or Undead Traits, mutations, and those with more Corruption points that WP Bonus + T Bonus. They cannot enter and if they are already in, they gain Broken Condition until they leave. No one in the protected area cannot gain any Corruption Points.

name: Choking Shadows
description: If the target needs to breath, they get +1 Fatigued Condition, cannot talk, and suffer from Suffocation.

name: Curse of Ill-Fortune
description: One of the ingredients must be an object belonging to the target. Target receives -10 to all Tests and cannot spend Fortune Points.

name: Screaming Skull
description: Create a screaming skull that moves in a straight line. Anyone in its path without Undead Trait takes magic missile Damage +WP Bonus. Anyone who lost Wounds due to this spell must pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test or gain Broken Condition.

name: Magic Flame
description: Create a small flame in your hand. The flame emits light and heat.

name: Sleep
description: Put the target to sleep.

name: Fearsome
description: Gain Fear 1. For every +2 SL increase Fear by 1.

name: Cerulean Shield
description: Gain +SL Armour Points to all locations  when calculating damage from melee attacks. If attacked by metal weapon, the attacker takes +WP Bonus Damage.

name: Fat of the Land
description: The target does not have to eat or drink for the duration of the spell.

name: Lifebloom
description: Bring life a desolated or blighted area. For example a barren field or dry riverbed.

name: Healing Light
description: Heals target's Wounds euqal to your Int + WP Bonuses. Targets may attempt a Very Hard (-30) Endurance Test to lose 1 Corruption point gained in the last hour.

name: Mystifying Miasma
description: Everyone in the affected area that do not have Arcane Magic (Shadows) Talent gains +1 Blinded, Deafened, and Fatigued Conditions which stay for the whole duration of the spell. Affected targets that try to move have to pass a Challenging (+0) Perception Test or receive Prone Condition.

name: Protective Charm
description: You enchant a small charm with spell of protection. The wearer gains Magic Resistance Talent. If the wearer already has this talent, the charm has no effect.

name: Vanhel's Call
description: Int Bonus Undead targets gain a free Move or Action (has to be the same for all targets). For every +2 SL, you can affect additional Int Bonus targets.

name: Shock
description: Target receives 1 Stunned Condition.

name: Beast Tongue
description: You can talk to creatures with Bestial Trait and get +20 to all Charm Animal and Animal Training Tests. While active you cannot speak non-bestial tongues.

name: Great Fires of U'Zhul
description: Hurl a great fireball at an enemy that deals magic missile +10 Damage that ignores AP and inflicts +2 Ablaze Conditions and Prone Condition. Everyone in the affected area around the target, receives magic missile +5 Damage (ignores AP) and must pass a Challenging (+0) Dodge Test to avoid getting Ablaze Condition. Sets the ground on fire.

name: Flaming Sword of Rhuin
description: Cover a sword in magical flames. The sword becomes +6 Damage and receives Impact Quality. Enemies hit by the affected sword gain +1 Ablaze Condition. If the wielder of the sword does not have Arcane Magic - Fire, they receive +1 Ablaze Condition whenever they fumble an attack. Talent

name: Earthpool
description: You move through the ground. After casting the spell, you disappear into the ground and reappear on the next Round at any point within Willpower yards. If you engage anyone after reappearing, they get a Surprised Condition.

name: Blight
description: Create blight (permanent) in a well, field, or a domestic animal.

name: Destroy Lesser Daemon
description: Target must have Daemonic Trait and WP lower than yours. Target loses WP Bonus Wounds that ignore Toughness Bonus and Armor. Increase one of your characteristics by +10 for the duration of the spell.

name: Raise Dead
description: Raise SL+1 Skeletons in the affected area. For each +2 SL, you may summon extra SL Skeletons.

name: Open Lock
description: Open any non-magical lock.

name: Rot
description: Cause rot to fist-sized volume of organic material such as food, cloth, or leather. Leather armor loses 1 AP on 1 location.

name: Spring
description: Water bubbles from the ground at a rate of 1 pint per Round for Initiative Bonus Rounds.

name: Wyssan's Wildform
description: Gain Arboreal, Armour (2), Belligerent, Big, Bite (Strength Bonus +1), Fear (1), Fury, Magical, Weapon (SB+2) Creature Traits. While the spell is active you cannot use any Language or Lore Skills.

name: The Third Portent of Amul
description: Gain +1 Fate. The point is lost if not spent before end of the spell.

name: Forge of Chamon
description: Target an item made of metal. You can add 1 Quality or remove 1 Flaw. For each +2 SL you can add/remove 1 extra Quality/Flaw.

name: Illusion
description: Create an illusion in the affected area. Only those with Second Sight Talent, if they pass a Difficult (-10) Perception Test, can notice that they are looking at an illusion.

name: Goodwill
description: Everyone in the affected area gains +10 to all Fellowship Tests and Animosity and Hatred Psychologies are suppressed.

name: Bearings
description: You know where the North is.

name: Protection from Rain
description: Keep yourself dry in rain, snow, etc.

name: Drop
description: The target must pass a Challenging (+0) Dex Test or they immediately drop the object they are holding. For every +2 SL add -10 penalty to the Test.

name: Push
description: Push back all living creatures within WP Bonus yards. The creatures are pushed back by WP bonus yards and gain Prone Condition. For every +2 SL, the creatures are pushed by an extra WP Bonus yards.

name: The Amber Spear
description: Create a spear that deals magic missile hit Damage +12 and pierces through leather and fur Armour. If the target suffers any Wounds, they also receive 1 Bleeding Condition, and the spear passes through, striking next target in its path. The spear deals -1 Damage for each target it goes through. If it does not cause any Wound on the target, the spear stops. Inflicts a minimum of 1 Wound on the first target.

name: The First Portent of Amul
description: Gain +1 Fortune Point and +1 additional point for each +2 SL. All extra points are lost if not spent before end of the spell.

name: Feather of Lead
description: For every target in the affected area chose one: Do not count as Overburdened or Count as two steps more Overburdened.

name: Speed of Thought
description: Gain +20 to Intelligence and Initiative.

name: Shroud of Invisibility
description: Target becomes invisible to anyone without Second Sight Talent. Those with Second Sight must pass Challenging (+0) Perception Test to notice someone is nearby.

name: The Evil Eye
description: The target must be looking at you. If you win Opposed Intimidate/Cool Test (add SL from casting roll to your result) the target gains +1 Fatigued Condition per +2 SL by which you win. If you win by 6 or more SL, they gain Broken Condition.

name: Stream of Corruption
description: Make a Breath attack as if you had spent 2 Advantage to activate the Breath Creature Trait.

name: Acquiescence
description: Reduce target's Initiative to 10. During its Turn all movement is random and they can perform Action only after passinf a Challenging (+0) Cool Test.

name: Animal Friend
description: Make friends with a creature (has Beast Trait) that is smaller than you.

name: Purify Water
description: Remove all non-magical impurities (such as poison) form water in a container. Non-water liquids are turned into water.

name: Sly Hands
description: Teleport 1 small object (up to the size of your fist) from your person to your hand.

name: Mirkride
description: Your spirit separates from the body that remains immobile and suffer Prone Condition. The spirit is invisible, immune to non-megical damage and can go through physical obstacles. It also has all you characteristics, skills, etc. and can cast spells. You can interact with other invisible creatures, spirits, ethereal creatures, and Daemons.

name: Creeping Menace
description: The target is attacked by swarm of Giant Rats, Giant Spiders, or Snakes. The swarm uses stats of regular creature with an extra Swarm Trait.

name: Treason of Tzeentch
description: Target cannot use Talents and cannot add Skill Advances when making Skill Tests.

name: Corrosive Blood
description: You gain Corrosive Blood Creature Trait.

name: Comet of Casandora
description: Call down a comet from the sky that deal magic missile Damage +12 to all affected targets at the end of the next round. Affected targets also gain Ablaze and Prone conditions.

name: Shadowstep
description: Teleport up to Willpower yards. Any Engaged enemies gain Surprised Condition.

name: Nepenthe
description: Create a powerful drink, that when drunk by someone, that someone can chose to completely forget one individual, permanently. The drink lasts WP Bonus rounds.

name: Nostrum
description: Must be cast on already prepared draught. If the potion is drank while the spell is active, it heals WP Bonus Wounds and cures 1 disease +1 extra disease for every +2 SL.

name: Detect Daemon
description: Detects any Daemons in any form in the range.

name: Move Object
description: You can move an un-animated object with your mind. with a Strengths equal to your Willpower.

name: Mundane Aura
description: Your magical abilities cannot be detected. While active you cannot cast any other spells.

name: Beast Master
description: Convince a creature with Bestial Trait that you are its pack master. It will instinctively understand your intentions.

name: Sanctify
description: Create a circle that cannot be crossed by creatures with Undead Trait.

name: Firewall
description: Create wall of fire that is WP Bonus yards wide, and 1 yard deep. Anyone trying to cross it receives magic missile Damage +WP Bonus and gains 1 Ablaze Condition. For each +2 SL you can extend the wall by WP Bonus yards.

name: The Second Portent of Amul
description: Gain +SL Fortune Point and +1 additional point for each +2 SL. All extra points are lost if not spent before end of the spell.

name: Glittering Robe
description: Gain the Ward (9+) Trait against all attacks. Each hit saved, increases rating of the Ward by 1, up to a max of Ward (3+).

name: Part the Branches
description: You can see invisible creatures even those impossible to see.

name: Produce Small Animal
description: Pull a small animal out of bag, pocket, etc. The animal must be appropriate to the location.

name: Amber Talons
description: Unarmed attacks count as Magical and deal Damage equal to your WP Bonus. If you attack cause Wounds, inflict +1 Bleeding condition.

name: Purple Pall of Shyish
description: Gain +WP Bonus AP on all locations, and Fear (1) Trait. For every +2 SL you may increase your Fear rating by 1.

name: Scythe of Shyish
description: Create a scythe (Polearm). It deals WP Bonus +3 damage. Enemies with Undead Trait do not receive Advantage when Engaged in combat with you.

name: Starcrossed
description: You can spend Fortune Points to force opponents to reroll Tests.

name: Crucible of Chamon
description: Instantly melt a metallic object. If the object was being worn, the wearer take magic missile Damage +WP Bonus that ignores Toughness Bonus.

name: Transmutation of Chamon
description: You change bodies of affected targets into metal. All targets take magic missile Damage +WP Bonus that ignores Toughness, +1 AP to all locations, receive +1 Blinded, Deafened,  Stunned Conditions that last whole duration of the spell, and suffer from Suffocation.

name: Sounds
description: Create small noises nearby. If you pass an Average (+20) Channelling Test you can move the source of sounds or increase/decrease volume.

name: Arrow Shield
description: Protects you from any missiles with organic matter (such as arrows).

name: Entangle
description: Target gains Entangled Condition with a Strength equal to your Int. For every +2 SL you may give the target an extra Entangled Condition. Lasts until all Entangled Conditions are removed.

name: Teleport
description: Teleport to a point up to WP Bonus yards. For every +2 SL you can increase the distance by WP Bonus yards.

name: Caress of Laniph
description: Deal magic missile Damage +6 that ignores Toughness Bonus and Armour. Heal 1 Wound for each 2 inflicted Wounds.

name: Swift Passing
description: Bring death to a target with 0 Wounds and at least 2 Critical Wounds. Target cannot be raised as Undead.

name: Purge
description: Set all flammable things on fire. All creatures receive +SL Ablaze Conditions. Burns all objects under Corrupting Influence. You can maintain this spell in subsequent rounds by passing a Challenging (+0) Channelling Test.

name: Net of Amyntok
description: Target gains +1 Stunned Condition that cannot be lost while the spell lasts. Creatures with Bestial Trait are immune.

name: Shadowsteed
description: Create a shadow steed. While not in sunlight it gains Dark Vision, Ethereal, Magical, Painless, Stealthy, Stride, Fear (1) and Ward (+9) Traits.

name: Haunting Horror
description: The location become haunted. Anyone in it, unless they have Magic (Witchcraft) Talent, gain +1 Fatigued Condition. They also need to pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test or gain another +1 Fatigued Condition and Broken Condition.

name: Aethyric Armour
description: Gain + 1 AP to all Hit Locations.

name: Steal Life
description: Targets receives magic missile Damage +6 that ignores Armour and  +1 Fatigued Condition. Remove all Fatigued Conditions you have currently and restore up to half (rounded up) of Wounds dealt.

name: Aqshy's Aegis
description: Become immune to non-magical fire and ignore Ablaze Condition. You also get Ward (9+) Creature Trait against magical fire attacks.

name: Forest of Thorns
description: Cover earth with tangled brambles. Anyone trying to go through it has to attempt a Hard (-20) Agility Test. If failed, they gain 1 Bleeding and 1 Entangled (with Strength equal to your WP). Conditions

name: Daemonbane
description: Casting Test is Opposed by Daemon's (creature with Daemonic Trait) Willpower Test. If succeeded the Daemon is destroyed and everyone looking at the process receive +SL Blinded Conditions unless they posses Arcane Magic (Light) Talent.

name: Dart
description: Create a magic missile with +0 Damage.

name: Aethyric Arms
description: Create a melee weapon with Damage equal to your WP Bonus. This weapon counts as magical.

name: Dying Words
description: You can talk to the soul of recently (up to 1 day) deceased.

name: Soul Vortex
description: All targets in the affected area receive +1 Broken Condition. Undead targets receive magic missile Damage +10 that ignores Toughness Bonus and Armour.

name: Barkskin
description: Target gains + 2 Toughness Bonus and -10 to Ag and Dex.

name: Doppelganger
description: Assume form any familiar humanoid. Only those with Second Sight Talent, if they pass a Difficult (-10) Perception Test, can notice that you are disguising your form.

name: Octagram
description: Targets with Daemonic Trait with WP lower than twice yours WP cannot enter or leave the affected area.

name: Belligerence of the Bloodmarsh
description: The Fenbeast gains the Frenzy Trait.

name: Collapse Construct
description: After successful Casting Test, make an Opposed Willpower/Toughness Test against the construct. If successful, the construct becomes lifeless.

name: Decipher Curse
description:
Successful cast reveals any curses on the item. If the item is indeed cursed, after successful reveal you must make a Challenging (+0) Intelligence Test. Failure means you suffer Moderate Exposure to
Corruption.

name: Disrupt Magic
description: Can be cast at someone who is channelling a spell. If successful, you can take an Opposed Willpower Test. If you succeed, the spell fails and they suffer a Minor Miscast.

name: Fly-Infested Rotweed
description: Arcane spell. The Fenbeast gains the Distracting Creature Trait.

name: Lifebloom Silt
description:
The affected Fenbeast regenerates double the number
of Wounds it normally does.

name: Silence
description: Creates a zone of silence around the caster. No sound can't be heard inside the zone. People outside the zone cannot hear anything emanating from it. Casting from inside the zone suffers a penalty of -3 SL.

name: Succour Magical Servant
target: One of your Familiars or Constructs
description: The creature imminently recovers Wounds equal to its Toughness Bonus. If you achieve +3 SL or more, it recovers twice its Toughness Bonus.

name: Bind Monstrous Beast
description: Learning XP: 400. CN is equal to the beast’s Wounds. You project your will onto that of the target beast. You must win an Opposed Willpower Test against the creature to control it.

name: Bind Spirit Within Power Stone
description: Learning XP: 600. If the ritual takes place at a Leyline Junction or Arcane Fulcrum, the CN is 16. Binds a minor spirit within a Power Stone.

name: Carve Ogham Stone
description: Learning XP: 450. Create an Ogham Stone. It it can have one of the following waystone properties: Attraction, Containment, or Dampening

name: Create Power Stone
description: Learning XP: 400. Create a Power Stone of a type corresponding to the Lore of Magic you work with.

name: Conjuration of the Bloody Hidesman
description: Learning XP: 500. The bloody totem takes on the form of an Incarnate Elemental of Beasts.

name: Conjuration of the Incarnate Elemental of Death
description: Learning XP: 500. The twin-headed serpentine form of an Incarnate Elemental of Death hatches from the hourglass.

name: Conjuration of the Jack O' Cinders
description: Learning XP: 500. Incarnate Elemental of Fire emerges from the pyre.

name: Corrupt Waystone
description: Learning XP: 450. Corrupts the waystone.

name: Create Construct
description: Learning XP: 400. Creates a Construct to serve its master. For the cost of extra CN, it can have additional traits.

name: Create Familiar
description: Learning XP: 250. Creates a Familiar. It can have extra traits for the cost of additional CN.

name: Create Waystone Property
description: Learning XP: 300. Alters the properties of a Waystone to create an Amplification, Containment, Dampening, or Refraction effect.

name: Cursecraft
description:
Learning XP: 200. CN and learning XP are halved for the following Lores: Witchcraft, Daemonology, Necromancy,
or any Chaos Lore. Imbues an item with a magical ability (boon) and a dangerous side-effect (bane).

name: Imbue Staff
description: Learning XP: 100.  Imbues staff with magical symbology.

name: Invocate Daemon
description: Learning XP: 400. Has CN equal to Daemon's Willpower. Summons a Daemon inside the Octagram.

name: Materialise the Living Swamp
description: Learning XP: 400. Marsh matter and vegetation coalesce into the form of a Fenbeast.

name: Remove Curse
description: Learning XP: 400. Removes Curse from the item (both boon and bane). The item retains Magical Quality.

name: The Crossed Scythes
description: Learning XP: 400. CN is equal to Undead entity's Willpower. Creates a barrier that cannot be crossed by Undead creatures.

name: Abulla's Snare
description: Lifts the target 2 yards above the ground. It gets 2 Entangled Conditions with a Strength equal to your Willpower.

name: Assault of Stone
description: The ground forms a hill 20 yards in diameter and 5 yards tall. Characters in the affected area have to take a a Challenging (+0) Dodge Test. They take 20 Damage to a random body location if they fail and 10 Damage if they pass. The hill is permanent.

name: Crevasse
description: You open a crack in the ground. Affected targets have to pass a Challenging (+0) Dodge Test to avoid falling in. When the spell ends, the crack closes crushing everyone inside for 20 Damage and burying them alive. Buried targets are subject to Suffocation.

name: Dazzling Brightness
description: A burst of purest light makes everyone in the affected area gain 1 Blinded Condition unless they possess the Arcane Magic (Light) Talent. All Daemons also gain 1 Stunned Condition.

name: Driving Intent
description: Provides the target with clarity and resolve. They get +2 SL to all Tests to resist Charm and Intimidation. If you cast it at yourself you may chose to receive +2 SL to Charm Tests instead.

name: Erect the Edifice
description: You raise the ground to create a crude wall. It counts as Hard Cover and Earthwork. Multiple castings can be use to create a building. It will collapse in Willpower Bonus + SL days unless you have or get an advice from someone with Lore - Engineering or Trade - Stoneworker skills.

name: Eyes of Volans
description: You can see Winds of Magic more clearly. You can see corruption (how many points) and mutations in civilised species, but not in plants or animals. You can see if creatures have Corrupted Trait. You also suffer -2 SL to vision-based Perception Tests and gain +20 bonus to Second Sight Tests to read the winds.

name: Hands of Karkora
description: Pale hands from the ground grab Targets' feet. Any target that fails a Challenging (+0) Dodge Test, becomes Grappled with a Strength equal to your Willpower.

name: Illuminate the Edifice
description: You illuminate inside of a building with daylight. Daemons and Undead must pass Challenging (+0) Willpower Test to enter the building. It they enter, they suffer Casting SL Damage that ignores Toughness Bonus and Armour.

name: Light of Purity
description: Enchants a light source. Everyone within light source gains Resistance - Disease Talent. All Wizards receive SL bonus to dispel Dark and Chaos magic. Range and duration are determined by the light source but cannot be more than 1 mile and 1 day.

name: Meissner’s Instantaneous Librarian
description: Allows to locate a desired scroll, tome, or grimoire, causing it to glow for Willpower Bonus + SL Rounds. It also contributes 1 + SL towards the target SL of an Extended Research Test.

name: Orb of Hysh
description: Allows you to telekinetically move an object with Encumbrance of up to Willpower Bonus + SL at a speed of Willpower Bonus. It also reduces by 1 level any Corruption Tests resulting from exposure to the object.

name: Perfect Comprehension
description: Lets you understand almost any language. The exceptions are Dark Tongue and some obscure ancient languages. Even though you understand it, you cannot communicate in it.

name: Pierce the Veil
description: Surrounds you with a magical field. Physical melee and missile attacks inflict only SL Wounds instead of their normal Damage. Magical attacks are unaffected. It completely protects you from other types of Damage (fire, falling, etc.). You can't hide while this spell lasts.

name: Time Amok
description: Alters the time. All allies in the affected area receive an extra action. Bonus actions are executed in initiative order.

name: Bridge
description: Creates bridge with length and breadth equal to your WP Bonus yards. For every +2 SL you can increase width of breadth by your WP Bonus yards.

name: Armour of Tin
description: Reduce any metal armour by 2 AP on every location.

name: Breach the Unknown
description: Grant you insight about the target. You know the creature or object as if you were studying it for a day. For every +2 SL learn a new detail. If casted on a magical object that you are touching, it has the same effect as Detect Artefact Talent.

name: Curse of Rust
description: Turns a non-magical metal object into rust making it useless. If you achieve +4 SL, the spell can also affect non-metal objects by making them brittle for WP Bonus minutes. Can be cast on object of 1 Encumbrance + 1 Encumbrance for each +2 SL.

name: Fault of Form
description: Changes the composition of a metal weapon making it worse. While the spell lasts, all Qualities are disabled and it gets -1 SL to Tests to this with it. Flaws Dangerous fumbles on an 8, 9, or doubles, Reload time is doubled, Slow provides +2 SL to defenders. Magical weapons are unaffected. However if you get +4 SL, their enchantments are temporarily negated.

name: Gehenna’s Golden Globe
description: Creates golden sphere. Those inside are affected by Golden Touch spell.

name: Gilded Cage
description: Creates a cage with bars made out of gold. Bars can be bend apart by passing a Hard (-20) Strength Test or cut with tools.

name: Golden Touch
description: The next living creature you touch changes into golden statue unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test. When petrified, they have 10 Toughness Bonus. If they receive any Wounds, the spell ends immedietly.

name: Goldsteel Shielding
description: Reinforces object with a golden cover. It increases its Armour by 4. Taking cover behind the object reduces Corruption by 2 levels and grants +1 SL to Dispel Tests made against spells targeting you.

name: Inscription
description: You can inscribe a metal surface by passing your hand over it. With +2 SL, you can encode it as a Secret Rune. Can also be use as a magic missile with Damage +2.

name: Knot Untied
description: Gives you an insight into a puzzle/riddle. Get 1 extra hint for each +2 SL. Relevant Lore Tests also receive a bonus of +2 SL

name: Metal Mended
description: Can be used to either repaid a damaged metal item (of any size) or fuse objects together.

name: Meteoric Ironclad
description: Affected targets gain a magical, weightless armour giving them Ward (4+) Creature Trait.

name: Prismatic Refraction of Habermas
description: All Channel and Cast Test suffer from -1 SL. When the spell expires, you may add +1 to a single Casting Test of spell of any colour. The bonus expires after 2 Rounds if not used.

name: Puchta's Silver Compass
description: Affected compass behaves as a Compass of Meteoric Silver

name: Replication of Levorg
description: Creates any simple object of up to 4 Encumbrance plus 1 for every +2 SL. It functions normally but a skilled person can recognise it's not natural. When spell expires, the object disappears. Alternatively, it conjures 1d10 Gold coins, plus 1d10 coins per +2 SL.

name: Trial and Error
description: Chose a Skill. The target receives +2 SL to the next Test of that skill. If you achieved +2 SL on the Casting Test, the target also gets 1 re-roll of that Test.

name: Almanac
description: You spend a day studying an area's natural flow of magic. After this time you can predict major seasonal and weather events. With +2 SL you can tell which week they will occur and with +4 SL you can tell the exact day.

name: Dwellers Below
description: Thousands of tiny earth spirits try to pull enemies to into the ground. If they don't pass Strength Test, they are pulled undergrounds and trapped in a "space between worlds" for 1d10 hours. After re-emerging they need to pass a Test for Moderate Exposure to Corruption.

name: Flesh of Stone
description: Turns target into a living stone. They can't talk and don't have to breathe. Their movement is halved, they get +30 to Strength and Toughness, and +4 AP to all locations. Unwilling targets can try to resist the spell by making an Opposed Willpower Test.

name: Gardener’s Warcry
description:
Summons a blood forest on a patch of earth. Anyone standing in the AoE takes 10 Damage and receives Bleeding Condition. Anyone passing the blood forest at more than half of their Movement speed, must pass a Challenging (+0) Agility Test
or suffer a Bleeding Condition.

name: Geyser
description: Summons a geyser that deals magic missile Damage + 4 to targets in the AoE. They also get knocked back WP Bonus yards in a direction of your choice, and receive Prone Condition. For every +2 SL you can give any single target a Stunned Condition.

name: Invigorating Chant
description: Awakes and/or invigorates plant-based creatures. They immediately heal SL Wounds and get +SL to all Tests. If the creatures were dormant, they have to wait 1 round before they can act.

name: Jade Casket
description: Temporarily reanimate a recently deceased (within last hour) creature. It can't speak and has its maximum Wounds, and obeys simple commands. It does not count as Undead.

name: Leaf Fall
description: Surrounds you with swirling leaves. Reduces Damage from falling, crushing, and blunt weapons by 3. Missile attacks against you suffer -2 SL, and you get Contortionist Talent.

name: Leyfinding
description:
Lets you sense nearby leylines and stone
circles. It gives +2 SL to Navigation Tests to finds leylines. You can sense leyline's strength and number of waystones in stone circles.

name: Nature’s Whisper
description: Lets you telepathically communicate with minor river or tree spirits.

name: Paranoth’s Pathway
description: Everyone in the AoE gains Strider - Woodlands Talent or +1 to its level if they already had it. For each +2 SL gain 1 more level of Strider. If you achieved +4 SL you can pass without trace.

name: Spiral Stair
description: A misty spiral staircase lifts you up WP yards. The height can be increased by additional WP yards for every +2 SL. While above you gain 3 AP to all locations.

name: Vaunted Transmogrification of Colchis
description: All characters and surfaces in the affected area become completely fire resistant and any fires are immediately extinguished.

name: Verdant Apotheosis
description: Brings back targets killed within the last minute. They have to take Test for Moderate Exposure to Corruption. Cannot heal critical Wounds, lost limbs, or bring back decapitated bodies.

name: Vital Growth
description: Target plant instantly grows to its maximum height. For +2/4/6 SL and extra 1/2/3 rounds of concentration casting the spell, you can double/triple/quadruple the maximum height.

name: Wood Shape
description: Transform target into a tree. While in a tree form, they can see and hear normally. Unwilling targets can attempt an Average (+20) WP Test to resist the spell.

name: Azure Blades
description: You surround yourself with a sphere of blades. Anyone engaged in Melee with you takes 3 hits of 8 Damage to random location every round during their turn. Cannot be dodged or parried. Special rules apply to enemies using long weapons.

name: Curse of Fate
description: Target suffers -10 to all Tests. Only 1 curse can be placed on any target at the same time. If you achieve +6 SL, you may chose to cast Fate of Doom instead. It makes the target permanently lose 1 Fate point.

name: Divination
description: You can chose 1 of 3 effects. Learn the best time for a future action. Locate lost or stolen object. Modify a single future die roll by plus or minus 10.

name: Enemy Foreseen
description: You cannot be Surprised.

name: Fantastic Foresight
description: All friendly wizards within the AoE (not including yourself) may reroll their first failure on all Channelling, Casting, and Dispel Tests.

name: Solmann’s Discombobulation
description: Forces all enemy wizards within the AoE to roll twice on any Channelling, Casting, and Dispel Tests. They have to select the worse roll.

name: Fate Illuminated
description: You can sense target's intentions or destiny. If you touch them, you can chose to see their Dooming and curses instead.

name: Lens on the Sky
description: A crystal disc appears and follows you around. When you look through it, you are able to see objects and creatures up to 3 miles away clearly. Gives a +2 bonus to any Perception Tests that involve long distances and eliminates penalties for clouds and fog. If you use it to look at stars, receive a +2 bonus on your next Navigation Test.

name: Let the Four Winds Blow!
description: Select 4 random vortex spells or groups of enemies to push them away from you. The distance is equal to your WP Bonus yards and can be increased by WP Bonus yards per +2 SL. Enemies that hit an obstacle or another character take 7 damage and become Prone.

name: Mistral From the Stratosphere
description: Shoot frigid Azyr from your hand in a chosen direction, hitting all targets within range for 12 damage (ignores Armour but not Toughness Bonus) and forcing them to roll a Hard (-20) Endurance test or suffer first stage of Cold Exposure.

name: Mystic Mirror
description: Communicate with a distant target via mirror or similar reflecting surface. Your reflection becomes visible and your voice can be heard from the target's mirror, and vice versa. You must know the target's name or have met them before.

name: Polish and Glean
description: Clean a glass object to make it spotless. With +2 SL, if the object is a lens or widow, it improves Lore (Astronomy) observation by +20. With +4 SL, it enhances visual Perception Tests using Second Sight Talent by +20.

name: Project Spirit
description: Separate your spirit from your body, which remains in a deep sleep. Your spirit is invisible and can pass through solid obstacles but cannot cast spells, communicate or manipulate objects. If you do not return to your body before the spell expires, you wake up and must Test against a Moderate Exposure to Corruption.

name: Sapphire Arch
description: Summon a 4-yard wide and 3-yard high arch of sapphire. Anything passing through it disappears into a limbo dimension and the arch vanishes after at the end of your next round. Next time you cast this spell, those inside return to the same spot without noticing time passed. If you die before recasting, they return at the original location, with Stunned and Prone Condition.

name: Starshine
description: Create a soft glow of light around you, revealing invisible targets and banishing darkness (normal and magical) within the AoE. It also reveals concealed creatures and doors, and moves with you for the duration of the spell.

name: Storm of Shemtek
target: 2 x Initiative Bonus or Initiative Bonus
description: Your body emits bolts of lightning equal to 2x your I Bonus. Each bolt is a magic missile with +6 Damage that you can direct at separate targets in front of you. You are immediately receive a Stunned Condition and anyone who see you without Arcane Lore - Heavens Talent must Test against a Fear (1). A safer variant calls down I Bonus lightning bolts within a target area of 2x your WP Bonus yards, without stunning or causing fear.

name: Thorsen's Thunderstorm
description: Summon a tornado that causes violent havoc, hitting targets within the AoE with magic missile of Damage +8 and blowing them in a random direction, as per the rules of "Let the Four Winds Blow!" spell.

name: Bewilder
description:
Target must pass a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test or they become confused. Roll 1d10 for confusion effect: 
1-2: Must pass a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test to take actions.
3-4: Move in a random direction.
5-6: Charge and Attack the nearest target.
7-8: Can only stand still and Dodge.
9-10: Receive Prone condition and become Helpless.

name: Black Horrors
description: Summon ghostly shade to haunt a shadowed area, causing Fear (1). +2 SL on Casting Test increases Fear rating by 1 (max Fear 4). Shadow becomes magical, remains shadowed even when illuminated.

name: Bridge of Shadows
description: Transport willing targets through air with shadows to a destination within line of sight up to WP yards (from start). You can fly with group if in AoE. Targets can't fly through solid objects, but they can fly over obstacles up to WP yards. Group arrives when spell expires.

name: Dance of Despair
description: Make enemies dance uncontrollably and lose focus. They can resist with a WP Test. If they fail, thy can't move or take any actions. To stop dancing, they must pass a Hard (-20) Athletics Test or Challenging Perform (Dance) Test. After the spell expires affected targets gain Fatigued Condition. Does not affect friendly and neutral characters.

name: Deep Pockets
description: Hide object in a pocket dimension. It becomes weightless and invisible. Containers with contents count as 1 object. Object must have Encumbrance of 1 + 1 for every +2 SL on Casting Test. The object cannot be found with Perception Tests. You can retrieve with an Action. The item is lost if spell duration ends before retrieval.

name: Grand Illusion
description: The Grand Illusion functions similarly to "Illusion" spell but it creates complete sensory illusions, including scent, touch, sound, taste, and appearance, not just static scenes. The illusion is real (has physical effects) to those who believe it.

name: Grey Wings
description: Summon grey birds to teleport you or one target up to 100 yards +100 yards for every +2 SL on Casting Test. Unwilling targets can Dodge with Easy (+40) Test.

name: Horn of Andar
description: Invoke horn blast affecting all in range. Friendly targets +2 SL bonus on Cool and Leadership Tests. Enemies get -2 SL on same tests and must pass Fear (1) Test. Neutral targets are unaffected.

name: Hush
description:
Create sound dampening aura that moves with target. Can't be cast on unwilling target, but can target objects. Select 1 of 3 forms at casting time:
No sounds leave AoE but sounds from outside can enter it.
No sounds enter AoE but sounds made inside AoE are unaffected.
No sounds are made in AoE.

name: Mutable Visage
description:
Change the appearance of a target. Those who do not consent can resist with Opposed Willpower Test. Select from the available options:
+/- 10 Fel
Target appears to be dead. They cannot speak or move.
Target becomes unrecognisable to the people who know them.

name: Pit of Tarnus
description: Open a dark pit in the ground. Targets near the pit must pass a (+0) Dodge Test or fall in. The pit closes when the spell ends, causing 20 damage and burying those inside alive causing Suffocation.

name: Ribauld's Retroactive Illusion
description: Creates an illusion in the past that changes the presence. You can teleport a terrain feature such at tree boulder etc. as long as it is smaller than a house. It cannot be a famous landmark and the new location must be sensible. Characters occupying the terrain feature teleport along with it.

name: Shadow Grove
description: Revels shadows of all creature, even those invisible. Possessed creatures have 2 shadows: their own and the daemon. Attacks against revealed creatures have -10 penalty.

name: Substance of Shadow
description: Make a target invisible and intangible if fully within a shadow. Can be cast on inanimate objects. Material attacks don't affect it, but magical ones do. The target can interact with physical objects but the spell ends if it leaves the shadow.

name: Traitor of Tarn
description: Make an enemy treat you as an ally if they fail an Opposed Willpower Test. They can break the spell by passing a Challenging (+0) Cool Test when asked to attack a former ally, but won't follow suicidal orders. On a neutral target, it grants +2 SL to Fellowship Tests instead.

name: Wandering Shadow
description: Allows you to control your detached shadow and see, hear, and smell from it. Directing its movement takes an Action. It is destroyed by direct sunlight or if it moves beyond 48 yards from a light source. It causes Fear (1) but cannot attack.

name: Acceptance of Fate
description: Friendly targets become immune to Fear and Terror is treated as Fear instead for the duration of the spell. All Psychology effects caused by grief are permanently removed. If cast on enemies, if they fail a Challenging (+0) Cool Test, they cannot flee combat.

name: Amaranth
description: The Critical Hit rolls against you are modified by -10. You gain Resistance to Poison, Disease, and Chaos Talents. If you already have these Talents, gain +1 level per +2 SL instead.

name: Animus Imprisoned
description: Trap target's soul in a bottle.Their body stays in coma until the bottle is re-opened nearby. Body has to be fed or it will die. When awakened, the target must Test for exposure to a Moderate Source of Corruption.

name: Ashes and Dust
description: Summon a swirling ball of dust. Affected targets are dealt 8 Damage ignoring Armour and start to Suffocate until they leave the cloud. With +4 SL, you summon Purple Sun of Xereus at the centre of the cloud. It causes Fear (2) and anything that touches it must pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test or die instantly.

name: Compel Spirits
description:
Command creatures with Undead and Ethereal Traits. Chose 1 of the 2 effects: 
Command all targets that fail Opposed Willpower Test.
Summon SL number of Ghosts. They are not under you command but you can subdue them by casting this spell again.

name: Crystal Maze
description:
Trap targets in Aethyr maze. At the end of their rounds, each one rolls 1d10:
1-3: They return to  original location.
4-6: Roll again next round.
7-9: Is lost for 1d10 hours and must  resist a Moderate Exposure to Corruption when they return.
10: Lost forever.

name: Death’s Release
description: Undead and Ethereal creatures must pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test each round or become Stunned. Spirits with 3 Stunned Conditions are freed from the mortal realm.

name: Fate of Bjuna
description:
Causes the targets to laugh hysterically. Each round they must pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test or suffer their own S Bonus + 6 Damage (50% chance on head, 50% on body) and receive Stunned Condition. For every +2 SL one you may surround 1 target with a purple fog. If they fail a a Challenging (+0) Willpower
Test, the fog starts Suffocating them for the duration for the spell.

name: Iyrtu's Embrace
description: Gain +10 S for every +1 SL and automatically succeed on all grapple attacks.

name: Limbwither
description:
If cast on a person's limb, it becomes completely useless and counts as amputated for WP Bonus minutes. 
Can also be cast as a ward on a grave. Whoever tries to uncover it, becomes subject to a curse that affects a random limb for WP Bonus days.

name: Shyish Uncovered
description: You become cognisant of all deaths that happened within the last month + 1 month for each +1 SL. If you are aware of a deceased person's name, you can ask them one question per additional +2 SL, which must be able to be answered through knocks.

name: Speed of Lykos
description: You grant supernatural speed to yourself or another target, allowing them to move 100 yards and take an action in the next round. If killed while under the spell's effect, the target can take an immediate bonus action before death.

name: Taste of Death
description:
A single (primary) target must Test for Minor
Exposure to Corruption and then pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test or receive an Unconscious Condition. All enemies in I Bonus yards of primary target must pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or receive a Stunned Condition. Anyone that did not pass the Cool Test, must pass an Easy (+40) Cool Test or receive a Fatigued Condition and Psychology - Despair.

name: Telepathy
description: Lets you telepathically send message to another r Amethyst wizard. Receiver of the message must pass a Challenging (+0) Intuition Test to understand you. It can also be used to read mind of another Amethyst Wizard. If they pass a Challenging (+0) Intelligence Test, they notice what you are doing and can try to block you with an Opposed Willpower Test.

name: Tide of Years
description: If used on a non-magical object it instantly ages it and it turns to dust. Object can have a max of 2 Encumbrance + 1 for every +2 SL. With more than +4 SL it can be used on living creatures. The creature must pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or grow older in a matter of seconds and permanently lose 1d10 of S and T each. Daemons, Undead, and plants are immune.

name: Wild Kin of Zandox
description: Summon 2 purple shadow hounds. They're invisible but a Hard (-20) Perception Test reveals them as beasts with sharp fangs. During you round they can attack within 4 yards. They have Weapon Skill 50 and Weapon - Bite (+8) Trait. They cannot be attacked and do not gain Advantage.

name: Body of Fire
description: You set your body on fire. Anyone attempting to grab or grapple you suffer 8 + SL Damage. Every turn they must Hard (-20) Cool Test or are forced to let you go. Every time you take damage in melee combat, you attacker must pass Challenging (+0) Dodge Test or suffer a magic missile hit with Damage +3 that ignores Armour

name: Boiling Blood
description:
You boil target's blood. If they resist a Difficult
(-10) Endurance Test, they immediately receive 2 Blinded Conditions and at the start of their round they receive 10 + SL Damage that ignores Armour. Anyone killed by this spell explodes. The explosion deals magic missile hit with Damage +1 to everyone within 2 yards.

name: Burning Head
description: Create a burning head that strikes all targets in its path. It causes magic missile with Damage + 4 (or +0 passes a Challenging (+0) Dodge Test). Everyone gets 1 Ablaze condition, and if they lose at least 1 Wound, they treat you as if you had Fear (1) Trait.

name: Captivating Flame
description: Causes a flame to mesmerise 1 random observer that must pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test or receive 3 Stunned Conditions. With +2 SL you may enchant a bigger fire that affects 2 observers, and with +4 SL you can enchant a massive fire that affects all observers.

name: Choleric
duration: Willpower Bonus hours, days, or weeks
description: Make the target dislike someone else. They are subject to Prejudice for WP bonus hours. If the two are friends, the target may may resist the spell with an Average (+20) Cool Test. With +4 SL the target is subject to Animosity for WP bonus days instead,  and with +8 SL they suffer from Hatred for WP bonus weeks instead.

name: Flamestorm
description: Summon a pillar of fire 2 yards in diameter and 2 yards high. For each +2 SL you can increase the diameter by 1 yard and height by 2 yards. Anyone standing where the pillar has appeared receives magic missile hit with Damage +8, 3 Ablaze Conditions,  Prone Condition, and are thrown outside of the storm.

name: Forge of Tarnus
description: Empower a forge. All Trade - Smith Tests gain + 1 SL.

name: Ignite
description: Set an object or a person on fire. The target receives 2 Ablaze Conditions. If they already have Ablaze Condition, you can distribute 3 Ablaze Conditions to others withing 2 yards of the target instead.

name: Inextinguishable Flame
duration: Willpower Bonus hours, days, weeks, or months
description: Create a fire (of size of campfire) that cannot be extinguished by any means for WP bonus hours. With +2/4/6 SL the duration is extended to WP bonus days/weeks/months. The only way to extinguish the fire is to cast "Inextinguishable Flame" spell on it. Cannot be dispelled by any other means.

name: Kindleflame
description: Everything in AoE becomes flammable. Everything that is already flammable takes +SL extra fire damage and receives an extra Ablaze Condition when damaged by fire.

name: Kindred of the Hearth
description: Summon a minor fire elemental to defend your camp. The elemental has Movement 3, WS equal to your WP, Fear (1) Trait, and attacks at Damage +6. Whenever its attack causes damage, the opponent gets 1 Ablaze Condition. It must stay within 12 yards from the fire and can be destroyed by extinguishing it with a pint of water.

name: Magma Storm
description: Summon a storm that causes magic missile hit with Damage +12 and inflicts 2 Ablaze Conditions. Every round it moved 8 yards or less it produces + 1 smaller vortex for every +2 SL. They immediately move randomly and last only one round. They inflict 1 Ablaze Condition and magic missile hit with Damage +4.

name: Sanguine Swords
description: Summons a magic sword that hovers in front of you. For every +2 SL you can summon additional sword up to 6 in total. You can spend you action directing the swords withing line of sight. Any single target can only be attacked by a 1 sword. The swords posses Fly (20) Creature, WS 60, and deal 8 Damage before returning quickly to you.

name: Taste of Fire
description:
Chose 1 of the 3 effects:
1. Post food becomes extremely spicy.
2. Jug of liquid becomes a strong alcohol.
3.  Flask of liquid becomes a highly flammable oil.

name: Withering Heat
description: All enemies in the AoE receive a Fatigued Condition every round they attempt to run, charge, or flee. If they are touched by any fire, they receive Ablaze Condition. In addition they suffer extra +SL Damage when subjected to fire damage.

name: Ygethmor's Flaming Blizzard
description: Create a blazing storm that deals 8 + SL Damage per round to all targets in AoE. Every round they must pass a Challenging (+0) Athletics Test or receive Prone Condition. Flammable objects have 25% chance to ignite each round.

name: Amber Trance
description: Transform target into an amber statue. They can try to resist by passing a Hard (-20) Cool Test. The spell ends if the statue is attacked but the first attack does not do damage. A willing target can enter a state of extended hibernation that lasts until the next equinox or solstice.

name: Awakening of the Wood
description:
Deals magic missile hit with Damage
+4 to all targets. Everyone in the AoE must also pass an Average (+20) Dodge Test or receive Bleeding and Entangled (Strength 30) Conditions.

name: Beast Unbroken
description: You make a domestic animal become wild. With +4 SL you can cast in on Humans. Humans can try to resist with a Difficult (-10) Willpower Test. The target grow thick body hair, lose speech, and starts behaving like a wild animal. The spell lasts until dispelled.

name: Curse of Anraheir
description: Summon small spirits to harass foes in AoE, causing -2 to Movement, and -20 to WS, BS, and Agi. Targets that leave AoE are followed by the spirits but suffer only -1/-10 penalties. Mounts are scared away and flee unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test.

name: Eyes of the Pack
description: The target can see through your eyes.

name: Follow Scent
description: Gain +20 to Track and Perception Tests that rely on smell, including Second Sight Tests to smell magic. You can also smell Corruption and Mutation in plants. animals, and animal dung.

name: Hunter's Moons
description: You howl at a moon to invigorate all allies (and yourself) in the AoE. Everyone gains + 1 Movement and +10 to Strength and Toughness.

name: Merciw's Monstrous Regiment
description: All allies in the AoE gain +30 to Strength and Toughness (up to max 100). This spell does not affect you.

name: Musk Spray
description:
Create a foul smelling musk. If you use it on character or object, you gain +2 SL to locate it later. Alternatively, you can mark an area (up to WP Bonus yards) as your territory. Wild animals will only enter if they are desperate and pass an Average
(+20) Cool Test. The smell lasts for 1 day + extra day for every +2 SL.

name: Quick Passage
description: Gain +1 Movement and Scale Sheer Surface and Strider (any one) Talents. If you already have them add 1 level + 1 more for each +2 SL. Gain +10 on Tests to avoid Entangled Conditions.

name: Summon Mount
description: Summon a wild animal to serve as your mount. You temporarily gain the Ride Skill for this animal equal to your Language - Magick Skill.

name: The Ox Stands
description: Makes allies immune to Fear and Terror. Immediately remove 1 + SL Broken Condition from all allies.

name: Transformation of Kadon
description: Transform yourself into a Large on Enormous Beast. If you achieve +4 SL or more, you can chose an optional Creature Trait or cast this spell on someone else instead. If you cast it on someone else, they can resist with an Opposed Willpower Test.

name: Vengeful Hood
description: Create an amber light aura that protects you against non-magical attacks. Every time attack successfully hits you, make a Challenging (+0) Cool Test. If you pass the Test, reduce damage taken by WP Bonus + SL. If the attack is reduced to 0, it is deflected. Deflected Ranged attacks hit a random target within 2 yards of you and deflected Melee attacks hit the attacker.

name: Winter Coat
description: Grow thick fur that protects you against attacks and cold. You are immune to Cold Exposure and Critical Hit rolls are reduced by 10. You also suffer -10 to Fel and Ag.

name: Writhing Worm
description: Summons a huge worm that wriggles to the target. The target suffers an Entangled Condition and it is Grappled (Strength 50). If the target loses grappling Opposed Strength Test, the worm can either add another Entangled Condition or dissolve 1 point of leather armour on all locations.

name: Bonecrusher
description: You crunch bones and deal magic missile +4 Damage that ignores AP. If it causes Critical Wound, add +20 to critical table roll.

name: Bullgorger
description: You consume a heart to give target +2 SB when determining Damage. When the spell ends, the target has to have a large meal or suffer a Fatigued Condition. Unwilling targets may try to oppose this spell with Difficult (+20) Cool Test.

name: Braingobbler
description: You devour an entire head to gain Fear 2 Creature Trait. If the late owner of the devoured head had a close relationship to someone who is affected by your Fear Trait, they make any Cool Tests to resist the Fear at a -20 penalty.

name: Taste Death
description: You consume a part of a corpse to learn how and when the creature died.

name: Trollguts
description: Give the target Regenerate Creature Trait. If the target is not an Ogre, when regenerating wounds, they pass an Average (+20) Endurance Test or the regenerated flesh will become green or blue (similar to Troll's skin).

name: The Maw
description: You devour a large beast to summon the Maw. Anyone in the AoE must take a Challenging (+0) Dodge Test. If they pass, they take Damage +8 hit with Damage reduced by 1 for each Dodge Test SL. Those who fail, fall in the Maw. They gain 3 Entangled Conditions (Strength 60) and take a Damage +10 hit. They cannot escape until all Entangled Conditions are removed. At the end of their turn they suffer Damage +10 hit.

name: Feast of the Fallen
description: You bathe a blade into the he blood of a freshly fallen foe. Any creatures you chose in AoE gain Vampiric Creature Trait. To benefit from it they only need to wound someone in melee combat (instead of biting). Unwilling targets may try to oppose it with a Difficult (+20) Endurance Test.

name: Dagger of the Art
description: Transform a stick into a dagger. It counts as Magical. Used against enemies with Ethereal or Corrupted Traits, it has SB + 8 instead of regular SB + 2. After the spell duration ends, you can keep the dagger by passing a Challenging (+0) Channelling Test every round.

name: Fellstave - Beastmen
description: You whittle a staff that acts as a ward against Beastmen. If any Beastmen come withing 100 yards, they receive a Broken Condition unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test.

name: Fellstave - Daemons
description: You whittle a staff that acts as a ward against Daemons. If any Daemons come withing 100 yards, they receive a Broken Condition unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test.

name: Fellstave - Orcs and Goblins
description: You whittle a staff that acts as a ward against Orcs and Goblins. If any Orcs or Goblins come withing 100 yards, they receive a Broken Condition unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test.

name: Fellstave - Ogres
description: You whittle a staff that acts as a ward against Ogres. If any Ogres come withing 100 yards, they receive a Broken Condition unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test.

name: Fellstave - Fimir
description: You whittle a staff that acts as a ward against Fimir. If any Fimir come withing 100 yards, they receive a Broken Condition unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test.

name: Fellstave - Trolls
description: You whittle a staff that acts as a ward against Trolls. If any Trolls come withing 100 yards, they receive a Broken Condition unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test.

name: Fellstave - Undead
description: You whittle a staff that acts as a ward against Undead. If any Undead come withing 100 yards, they receive a Broken Condition unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test.

name: Goodwill
description: All Fel Test receive +10 bonus. Animosity and Hatred Psychologies have no effect.

name: Invigorate
description: Target ignores all Fatigued Conditions.

name: Lovelock
description: When you cast this spell honey drips from your lips. You must catch it in a cup. Whoever drinks from the cup, they fall in love in the first person they would find romanticallly appaeling.

name: Protection Pouch
description: You create a crop of purple herbs and put them in a pouch. The pouch provides wearer with +1 SL to any Cool Tests to resist supernatural effects and +1 SL to Endurance Tests to resist contracting diseases or suffering from Poisoned Conditions.

name: Silvertide
description: Over the course of the spell you find 1d10 pennies.

name: The Ousting
description: The creature with Ethereal or Daemonic Trait must pass a Challenging (+0) WP Test or suffer a number of Wounds equal to your WP Bonus. If this reduces their Wounds to 0 or belowe they are banished and canot return for 1d10 years.

name: Wyrd Ward
description: If you secceed an Opposed WP Test with the target, they receive -2 SL to any spell casting Tests from the Lores of Witchcraft, Necromancy, Daemonology, and all Chaos Lores.

name: Living Mire
description: Cover ship with seaweed. It suffers -2 to Movement and and adjusts its Manoeuvre Characteristic by -3 SL.

name: Water Water Everywhere
description: Replenish all empty barrels of water on the ship.

name: Whirlpool
description: Create a whirpool (Gentle Rotation) in the target area. Can be overcasted: 5 SL Whirpool, 8 SL Powerful Vortex, 13 A Maelstorm, 21 The Maelstrom.

name: Blessings of Bel Shanaar
description: +2 SL to all Navigation Tests made by you individually or as part of a Crew.

name: Niezlib's Optimal Firing Solution
description: +1 SL to Tests made to fire a ship's cannon.

name: Sea of Glass
description: Apply the Doldrums effect from the Wind Effect Table to your ship.

name: Blast of Corruption
description: Deal magic missile with Damage +5 to all affected targets. Each target must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test, or gain 1 Corruption.

name: Bolt of Corruption
description: Deal magic missile with Damage +6. The target must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test, or gain 1 Corruption.

name: Daemonic Mien
description:
Your body transforms and assumes aspects of a
Daemon loyal to your patron god. The trait is determined by 1d10 roll on the table on page 78. Each +2 SL lets you roll again and increase the duration. When the spell should end, you may make a WP Test to extend the Duration for+1 Round.

name: Foul Messenger
description: Invisible minor daemons will carry your message (max 25 words). For every +2 SLs, you may double the length of the message.

name: Joyous Aspect
description: Make the target to appear without flaw. It hides any scars, deformities and Mutations. When the spell should end, you may make a Willpower Test to extend the Duration for +1 Round.

name: Obsession
description: You cast this spell on something that belongs to the target. The object causes the target to become obsessed with something that depends on the individual and your Lore. Every hour the target must pass a an Average (+20) Endurance Test every hour, or succumb to their obsession.

name: Power of Chaos
description: Spells being cast in the AoE have their CN cost halved. The casting Tests have Average (+20) Difficulty. Everyone in the AoE must pass an Average (+20) Endurance at the end of each Rounds or they gain 1 Corruption point.

name: Rend Aethyr
description: You open a portal to the Realms of Chaos. At the end of every Round, 1 + 1 for every +5 SL Lesser Daemons come through the portal. When the spell should end, you may make a WP Test to extend the Duration for+1 Round.

name: Slave to Darkness
description: You ask you god to take the soul of your target. You must win an Opposed Willpower Test  by at least 2+ SL. If you Fumble the Test, your soul is taken instead.

name: Boon of Tzeentch
description: Choose one Spell from any Lore. For the duration of the Boon of Tzeentch, you can cast the selected Spell as if you had memorised it.

name: The Purple Hand
description:
Make palms of the target’s hands turn a deep
purple. Last 1 hour for every SL. To cast it, you must have some small amount matter from the target. Used to discipline Purple Hand co-conspirators.

name: Curse of Tzeentch
description: Make an opposed WP Test. If won, the target forgets a randomly selected spell for 1 day for every SL of the opposed Test.

name: Blue Fire of Tzeentch
description: Targets in the AoE suffer magic missile hit (Damage +3) and gain 1 Ablaze Condition. If Wounds of a target with size Small or larger are reduced to 0,  roll 1d10. If you roll 9, the target dies and 2 Blue Horrors come out of its burning flesh.

name: Bolt of Change
description: The Target suffers magic missile hit (Damage +7) and must pass a a Challenging (+0) Endurance or gain 1 Corruption point. On a fumble, the target immediately rolls for a Mutation, and gains the Chaos Magic - Tzeentch Talent.

name: The Flickering Flames of Fickle Fate
description: Conjure a torrent of magical fire. Every living creature and Daemons that can see it can reroll every Test once, as if they had spent a Fortune Point. Each time they do it, the must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain 1 Corruption point. When the spell should end, you may make a WP Test to extend the Duration for+1 Round.

name: Master of Fortune
description: Gain a Fortune point (for the duration of the spell) for every positive SL. If the casting fails, gain 1 Corruption point for every negative SL.

name: Mindfire
description: The target must pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test, or gain 1 Corruption point + 1 more for each 2 SL. If the target reaches Mutation threshold, they roll on Mental Mutations table and gain 1 Ablaze Condition.

name: Pink Fire of Tzeentch
description: The target suffers magic missile hit (Damage +6) and gains 1 Ablaze Condition. If Wounds of a target with size Small or larger are reduced to 0, roll 1d10. If you roll 9, the target dies and 1 Pink Horror comes out of its writhing corpse.

name: Sense the Skein
description: Select a target you can see. You discover the target's Motivation, Short-Term Ambition, and Long-Term Ambition.

name: Transformation of Tzeentch
description: The target suffers from Prone Condition, and is considered Helpless for the duration of the Spell. At the end of the duration, they must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test opposed by your Language - Magick Skill. If they lose the Test, they gain 1 Corruption point + 1 for every SL they lost by.

name: Tzeentch's Firestorm
description: Targets in the AoE suffer magic missile hit (Damage +9) and gain 1 Ablaze Condition. If Wounds of a target with size Small or larger are reduced to 0, roll 1d10. If you roll 9, the target dies and 2 Pink Horrors come out of its burning flesh.

name: Tzeentch's Golden Aura
description: You gain Ward 9+ Creature Trait.

name: Word of Tzeentch
description:
The target must take Opposed Int Test with you. If they lose, they gain 1 Stunned +1 for each SL they lost by. If they Fumble, they gain the Unconscious Condition and 1 Corruption point.
After all Conditions are removed, they must pass an Average (+20) Endurance Test or gain 1 Corruption Point. If they Fumble, they get 1 mental mutation and cannot not take a Short-term Ambition for the next 1d10 weeks.

name: Beast Tongue
description: You can speak and understand Language - Beast Tongue.

name: Eyes of the Beast
description: Gain Night Vision Creature Trait. If you already have it, your vision range doubles.

name: Sign of the Beast
description: Beastmen of Tzeentch are friendly to you. Gain +20 Fel to all Tests dealing with them. Followers of Khorne and Slaanesh suffer Animosity towards you. Followers of Nurgle suffer Hatred towards you.

name: Bension of Tzeentch
description: Gain +10 to one of: WS, T, ag, WP.

name: Bestial Rage
description: Gain Fury Creature Trait.

name: Climb
description: Fingernails on your hands and feet become claws, allowing you to climb if you are barefoot and without gloves. Gain Scale Sheer Surface Talent.

name: Enrage Beast
description: Cause fear in a single ordinary animal. If it fails a WP Test to resist, it acts strangely. The outcomes range from gaining Broken Conditions to instant death. To determine the effect, roll 1d10 on a table from page 98.

name: Slave to Chaos
description:
If the target fails WP Test to resist the spell, you gain control over their body. If you try to force them to self-harm, they get another WP Test to try to break the spell. When the spell ends, the victim must make a Challenging (-10) WP Test or gain one
mutation from the Tzeentch column from p 66 of Enemy in Shadows Companion.

name: Gift of the Beast
description: Gain a temporary mutation. Roll 1d10: 1: Animalistic Legs (+1 Movement), 2: Beaked Face (Bite +3 Trait), 3: Claws (Claw +3 Trait), 4: Fur (Armour 1 on all locations), 5: Horns (Horns +4 Trait), 6: Tail (Tail-lash +3 Trait), 7: Webbed Feet (Amphibious Trait), 8: Wings (Flight 60 Trait), 9-10: Roll twice.

name: Subvert Strength
description: |You touch a non-magic inanimate object. It comes soft and malleable. Weapons bend and break, Armour lose all AP. You can shape this material as you like.

name: Transformation of the Beast
description: You transform into a Gor (WFRP p. 331). Your characteristics are either your own or that of Gor (whichever is higher). Gain Armour 1, Fury, and Horns +6 Creature Traits. You also gain Language - Beast Tongue but lose ability to speak in any other language.

name: Tremor
description: The ground shakes as you stomp. All targets in WP Bonus yards have to make an Ag Test or fall down and gain a Prone Condition.

name: Befuddle
description: The target must pass a WP Test or gains one Stunned Condition.

name: Blessing of Slaanesh
description: Add +10 to your Int or Fel characteristics.

name: Endure Excess
description: You ignore Fatigued conditions for as long as you do something you enjoy. When you stop, the conditions return and you lose 1 Wound ignoring your TB and armour.

name: Leer
description: You may make one Called Shot against the target without taking the usual -20 penalty.

name: Lure
description: Imbue an object with essence of desire. Anyone who likes that sort of objects with find this one particularly desirable.

name: Preen
description: Your body and clothing become instantly clean. Anyone who pays close attention will notice that details that slightly off. For example, on closer look, your hair looks greasy.

name: Sense Vice
description: You look your target in the eye. If you pass an opposed Intuition/Cool Test, you learn about 1 of target's vices.

name: Acquiescence
description: Reduce target's I to 10. Target's movement becomes random and they have to pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test to perform any Action.

name: Aura of Acquiescence
description: Reduce I of all targets to 10. Their movement becomes random and they have to pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test to perform any Action.

name: Bonds of Slaanesh
description: Targets gains 1 Entangled Condition for each SL.

name: Breath of Inspiration
description: The target gains a bonus to one Test equal to your WP, after which the effect ends.

name: Blissful Throes
description: Deal magic missile with Damage +6. If it hits the head location, you may inflict Entangled Condition using your WP instead of S for purposes of the Opposed Test. It lasts WP bonus Rounds.

name: Cacophonic Caress
description: All targets receive Damage +3 hit per SL that ignores Armour.

name: Careless Whispers
description: Make an Extended Opposed Cool Test, with 6 required SLs. The winner can hear loser's current Ambition. They also have to pass a Cool Test or gain 1 Corruption point.

name: Chaos Spawn
description: The targets rolls once on the Physical or Mental Corruption Tables for each SL.

name: Cursed Caress
description: The targets rolls on the Head Critical Wounds table. The results is as rolled but there are no broken bones.

name: Cutting Wit
description: Deal magic missile with a Damage of +3 that ignores Armour.

name: Delicious Excruciation
description: Remove all Broken Conditions from the target. It cannot gain new ones for the duration of the spell.

name: Fleshy Curse
description: Causes 1 target to sprout horrible, uncontrollable growths. The growths are permanent. When the spell is cast and at the beginning of each round, the target can attempt a Hard (-20) Cool Test to resist the spell. If failed, roll on table on p. 38 to determine effects of the curse during that round.

name: Flesh Puppet
description: Make an Extended Opposed Cool Test, with 6 required SLs. If you win you get full control of target's body. When the spell ends, the target is aware they have been controlled and if they pass a Challenging (+0) Intuition Test, they can tell who controlled them.

name: From Pain, Pleasure
description: The target gains the Painless Creature Trait. If they suffer a Critical Wound, they must pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or they drop their weapon and stand helplessly.

name: Lash of Slaanesh
description: Deal Damage +5 hit. The target must pass a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test (the difficulty increases by 1 step per SL) or gain a Stunned Condition.

name: Gift of Slaanesh
description: Slaanesh bestows his gift on you. To determine the gift, roll 1d10 on table on p. 39.

name: Luxurious Torment
description: All affected targets enter the Frenzy state. They attack nearest creature.

name: Mask of Desire
description: Remove all Conditions from the target. All their visible wounds are masked for the duration of the spell. They also benefit from +10 to all Fel Tests.

name: Pavane of Slaanesh
description: All targets make a Challenging (+0) Cool Test. If they fail, all they can do is dance lewdly. If attacked, they are Surprised for the first round of combat.

name: Phantasmagoria
description: You and your allies gain Distracting Creature Trait.

name: Succubus's Caress
description: Every hour, the target must pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or be overcome by pleasure. On the first failure, they gain 1 Fatigued Condition. On every next failure, they gain 1 Blinded and 1 Deafened Conditions. If the sum of Blinded and Deafened Conditions is equal or greater than their Initiative Bonus, they gain Unconscious Condition. When the spell ends, all Conditions other than the Fatigued Condition are removed.

name: Summon Daemonette
description: Summon a Daemonette that can appear anywhere within spell's range. It is not under your control, but can be bargained with.

name: Summon Daemonette Pack
description: Summon a number of Daemonettes equal to your WP Bonus. They can appear anywhere within spell's range. They are not under your control, but can be bargained with.

name: Titillating Delusions
description: Create an illusion of your enemy's deepest desire. Each Round, all enemies that can see it, must pass a Challenging (+0) WP Test or spend entire Round moving towards it. Those who reach it, must pass a Challenging (+0) WP Test every Round. If they fail, they spend the Round trying to grasp the illusion.

name: Snitch
description: You weave subtle webs and tie them to an object. You become aware of any creature of size Small or larger that gets within WP Bonus Yards of the object.

name: Favour of the Horned Rat
description: Gain 1 Fortune point for the duration of the spell. You can only gain the extra point once every 13 hours.

name: Ghostly Flame
description: Create a small blob of green glowing fire. It burns for 1 hour and gives as much light as a torch. You can throw at an enemy in which case you use Ranged (Throwing) Skill and it does SB + WPB Damage.

name: Mark of the Horned Rat
description: The target must pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test or gets an ugly weeping sore on their head that reduces all Fellowship Tests by -10.

name: Rat Thrall
description: Summon a rat that will obey all your commands.

name: Vector
description:
The target must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance
Test or they get -20 to all Tests to resist disease. Targets with Resistance - Disease may use it to resist this spell.

name: Curse of the Horned Rat
description: All creatures in the AoE have to pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or be transformed into Skaven of size appropriate their size.

name: Death Frenzy
description: Target Skaven becomes subject to Frenzy. Unwilling Skavens may take a Challenging (+0) Cool Test to resist the spell. If they do, they lose 1 Wound as they bite their own body to distract themselves.

name: Musk of Terror
description: Targets become subjects to Terror (1) effect or Terror (2) for Skaven.

name: Skitterleap
description: Teleport yourself and 1 other creature (of Average size or smaller) to any location you can see within WP yards. Unwilling targets may try to avoid being touched and/or change destination by +SL yards by passing a Difficult (-10) Cool Test.

name: Vermintide
description: Summon a swarm of rats that you can control for Willpower Bonus rounds. After that, you lose control of them and they move and attack at random. After the spell ends, the rats disperse.

name: Crack’s Call
description: Create a 1-yard wide crack in the ground that extends Willpower yards  in a straight line in any direction within your line of sight.

name: Crackling Doom
