description: Cast a magic missile with a Damage of +4. Struck enemy must make a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain 1 Stunned Condition for each SL.

name: Flensing Ruin
description: Cast a magic missile with a Damage of +4 that ignores armour and Toughness Bonus.

name: Howling Warpgale
description: Enemies cannot fly in the affected area and all ranged attacks in or out of it suffer a -10 penalty. Allies are not affected.

name: Scorch
description: Cast a magic missile with a Damage of +10. Damaged enemies also gain 1 Ablaze Condition and suffer from Minor Exposure to Corruption.

name: Warp Lightning
description: Cast a magic missile with a Damage of +11. If the hit location is covered with metal armour, ignore AP and instead add it to the Damage. In case of Critical Success you also take a Damage +1 hit.

name: Warp Shield
description: Gain +5 AP to all hit locations. Anyone that touches you takes a hit with Damage equal to 5 + your WP Bonus to the hit location used to touch you. This hit ignores AP from metal armour.

name: Warp Storm
description: Each round, all creatures in the AoE  take Damage +10 hit to the highest point of their body. This hit ignores AP from metal armour. Every round the caster may move the AoE by Willpower yards.

name: Pestilent Breath
description: Anyone within the AoE must pass a a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test or suffer a hit with Damage equal to your WP Bonus. This Damage ignores Toughness Bonus and AP. For each additional +2 SL, you can extend AoE by 1 yard.

name: Poisonous Pustule
description: Create a pustule on your body. You can cut and drain it (deals 1 Wound) and coat a weapon with the fluid. If the coated weapon deals at least 1 Wound, the victim has to pass a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or suffer extra Wounds equal to your Willpower Bonus. Once drained, the fluid remains active for Willpower Bonus hours.

name: Bless with Filth
description: You can touch 1 weapon or 3 ammunition items.  The touched item causes a Poisoned Condition in addition to its normal damage.

name: Bless with Filth - v2
description: Every character in the AoE counts as possessing the Infected Creature Trait.

name: Cloud of Corruption
description: Every creature in the AoE must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain 1 Poisoned Condition. Your attacks gain Infected Creature Trait for the next  WP Bonus rounds.

name: Mantle of Contagion
description: You taint a piece of food or clothing with Black Plague.

name: Putrefy
description: You cause rot and decay in all food in the AoE. Anyone who eats it will suffer from Galloping Trots.

name: Toxic Rain
description: Starting from the next round, all creatures must pass a Difficult (-10) Toughness every round or loose 3 Wounds ignoring AP and T Bonus. Anyone who loses 6 or more Wounds, gains Unconscious Condition. As an action, you can move AoE within Willpower yards of your location.

name: Veil of Flies
description: Create a swarm of flies that surrounds you. Any other creature in the AoE receives a -20 penalty to all Tests. In addition, anyone trying to attack you using ranged skill receives -20 penalty.

name: Weeping Wound
description: Every Wound target receives counts as Minor Infection. All Endurance Tests to avoid Festering Wounds suffer a -10 penalty for each SL. Every time they receive Bleeding Condition, they receive 1 extra Bleeding Condition.

name: Wither
description: If the target fails Challenging (+0) Endurance Test, they lose 1 point of T for each SL. Creatures who lose all points are killed. Victims who survive regain 1 point per day of complete rest and additional 1d10 points if treated with healing capable of removing Critical Wounds.

name: Swiftscamper
description: Increase your Movement by WP Bonus. For every +2 SL, your Movement increases by an extra point.

name: Armour of Darkness
description: Gain +1 AP to all locations and +20 to all Stealth Tests in dim light.

name: Black Whirlwind
description: Every round, you can move the whirlwind by up 10 yards without sacrificing an Action. Targets affected by the Black Whirlwind have to pass an a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or suffer a -20 penalty on all WS, BS, and Ag, and Perception (involving eyesight) Tests for 1d10 minutes.

name: Buoyant Passage
description: You can walk over water or similar as if it was solid ground. In addition, you don't leave tracks when moving over soft surface such as mud or snow.

name: Flash-Bang
description: Everyone in the AoE must make a successful Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain 1 Stunned and 1 Blinded Conditions for each level of failure. On a critical failure, they gain extra Stunned Condition. Does not affect anyone with Arcane Magic - Stealth Talent.

name: Pelt of the Assassin
description: Your fur changed colour to match your surroundings. When perfectly still, you gain a +40 bonus to all Stealth Tests.

name: Stickypaws
description: Gain Wallcrawler Creature Trait.

name: Traceless Demise
description: If the target dies while under the effects of Traceless Demise, its body and all equipment dissolve into black slime.

name: Warp Star Infusion
description: Enchant a number of Throwing Stars equal to your WP Bonus. Anyone hit by such star, must pass a Hard (-20) Toughness Test or suffer Wounds equal to your WP Bonus that ignores AP and T Bonus.

name: Spirit Walk
description: Gain Ethereal Trait.

name: Cunnin' Words
description: You trick the target into thinking that you speak in regular manner.

name: Gork'll Fix It
description: The targets gains 1 + SL  Fatigued Conditions.

name: Night Shroud
description: Anyone in the AoE without Night Vision or Dark vision gains Blinded Condition. if they want to move, they must pass a Challenging (+0) Perception Test or gain Prone Condition.

name: Sneaky Stabbin'
target: Orc, Goblin, Snotling, and Hobgoblin allies within Range
description: All hits made targets of this spell gain Impale and Penetrating Qualities.

name: Vindictive Glare
description: All enemies in the AoE are hit with magic missile with Damage +4. Anyone who takes damage, has to make a Challenging (+0) Cool Test or gain a Stunned Condition.

name: Reveal the Inner Beauty
description:
You cause creature or object to age and decay rapidly. A living creature must make a Challenging (+0) Toughness
Test or ages 2d10 years and permanently loses –1d10 from their WS, BS, S, T Ag, and Dex.

name: Spirit-Bonding Ritual
description: Learning XP: 150. Bonds with Animal Familiar.

name: A Bite of Midges
description: Fimir Marsh Magic Spell. All warm-blooded creatures are hit with +2 Damage at the end of each round and must make an Average (+20) Endurance Test or gain  Blinded and Fatigued Conditions.

name: Despondent Slough
description: Fimir Marsh Magic Spell. Target gains one Entangled Condition with a Strength equal to your Int, plus 1 extra Entangled Condition for each + 2 SL. Each round, the target has to pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or gain a Fatigued Condition. The spell lasts until all Entangled Conditions are removed.

name: Inculcate Mizzle
description: Fimir Marsh Magic Spell. Targets have to pass Easy (+40) Endurance Test or gain a Fatigued Condition. All Tests to shoot blackpowder weapons, cast spells from the Lore of Fire, or enter Frenzy suffer -2 SL.

name: Mystic Mist
description: Fimir Marsh Magic Spell.Everyone in the affected area that do not have Arcane Magic (Shadows) Talent gains +1 Blinded, Deafened, and Fatigued Conditions which stay for the whole duration of the spell. Affected targets that try to move have to pass a Challenging (+0) Perception Test or receive Prone Condition.

name: O Mere Be More
description: Fimir Marsh Magic Spell. Stand one foot in water and the other on dry land. The edge of the marsh creeps outward across the Area of Effect.

name: Turned Around
description: Fimir Marsh Magic Spell. Target suffers from -3 SL to any Navigation Tests in the swamp area.

name: Apotheosis
description: Target recovers WP Bonus of Wounds and gains Fear 1 Creature Trait. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Arcane Unforging
description: Target suffers 1 Damage to the body for every 2 Armour Points worn. This Damage ignores APs. If you pass a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test, 1 randomly selected magic item in target's possession is destroyed. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Drain Magic
description: Dispels all persistent spells in the AoE. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Uproot the Mountains
description: You make a mountain or hill shake. Everyone who is there has to pass a Very Hard (-30) Athletics Test at the start of their Round. If they fail, they gain a Prone Condition and cannot move or take any action. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Walk Between Worlds
description: Targets gain Ethereal Creature Trait and their Movement Points are doubled. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Earth Line
description:
Anyone on the leyline must pass a
Hard (-20) Endurance Test or suffer 15 Damage that ignores APs. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Ruination of Cities
description: Completely destroy 1 building. Anyone inside must pass a  Hard (-20) Dodge Test or suffers 20 Damage and is buried alive. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Mental Blast
description:
Deal Int Bonus + 6 Damage to all targets in the AoE. This damage ignores APs. Deal extra 6 Damage to anyone with Daemonic or Undead Traits. Targets must pass an Average (+20)
Int Test or gain a Stunned Condition. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Bash 'Em Lads!
description: Give an allied Orc, Goblin, or Hobgoblin 1+SL Advantage points. All points maybe be given to a single target or distributed to many targets.

name: 'Eadbutt!
description: Magic Missile with a Damage of +1 that always hits head location. If the target has Aethyric Attunement or Second Sight Talents, the damage is +6 instead.

name: Fists of Gork
description: You drop anything you were holding and can only attack with your fists. You gain Melee - Brawling 55 and Weapon - Fists +9.

name: Mork Save Us!
description: For each SL, you may give 1 allied Orc or Goblin Ward 10 Creature Trait. If they already have Ward x, this spell makes it Ward x-1. This cannot reduce Ward below 7.

name: Shroud of Fog
description: Summon a fog that reduces visibility to 10 yards. The fog is not magical and cannot be Dispelled.

name: Itchy Nuisance
description: Target suffers a -10 to all Tests, and its Movement is halved.

name: Sneaky Stabbin' - v2
description: All targets gain +1 Advantage and their weapons gain the Penetrating Quality for as long as they have Advantage.

name: Ceaseless Flame
description: Creates a small magical flame that cannot be extinguished and does not need fuel.

name: Comfort
description: Creates an area of warmth in an cold environment. Any Outdoor Survival Tests to make camp inside the area, can be no worse than Average (+20).

name: Flashcook
description: Instantly cooks a meat, pot of stew or similar. If cast on a living creature, it's a magic missile dealing +3 Damage, which also inflicts one Stunned Condition on anything that can feel pain. If the location is an arm, the target has to pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or drop whatever they are holding.

name: Birdspeech
description: During the duration of this spell you can communicate with any birds, but you cannot communicate in any other language (you can only make bird sounds).

name: Weathervane
description: You learn about the future weather in your location for the rest of the day and tomorrow. With +2SL you learn the weather for the following weak, with +4SL for the following month, and with +6SL for the rest of the season.

name: Gale
description: Summon a gale for WP Bonus Rounds. It extinguishes all torches and fires, and anything with Ablaze Conditions loses 1 Condition per Round. Targets must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or are sent flying 1d10 yards backwards and gain 1 Prone Condition. Alternatively summon a gentler wind for WP Bonus hours. It has no dramatic effect but can, for example, fill the sail for the duration of this spell.

name: Rigor of Steel
description: Non-metal object behaves as if it was metal but its appearance does not change. The item gains all the usual Qualities and Flaws of a typical metal object of that sort. At the end of the spell roll 1d10. 1: the item is destroyed; 2-3: the item becomes degraded and torn; 4-10: no effect. Cannot be cast on already enchanted items.

name: Sense Metal
description: You can sense all metal within range of the spell as long as it is not hidden behind other metal. You can tell metal type, rough shape and precise location. For more details you must pass Challenging (+0) Perception Test.

name: Tale of Metal
description: You learn the history of an metal object. For example when it was forged, any significant moments in its existence, and how it used during during the last day.

name: Beast Made Well
description: Heal WP Bonus +SL Wounds of any beast. Gain +20 to Charm Animal Tests of the healed beast.

name: Cruelty's Deserts
description: Mark a beast. Other beasts will avoid it unless attacked. Anyone that passes a a Hard (-20) Intuition Test senses that this creature is protected and should not be harmed. Anyone who injures it suffers -10 Fel for the duration of this spell. In addition, other beasts of the same species will either avoid the abuser or be aggressive towards them.

name: Wyssan's Ally
description: Target beast gains one of the following Creature Traits: Arboreal, Armour (2), Belligerent, Big, Bite (Strength Bonus +1), Clever, Fast, Fear (10), Fury, Magical, or Weapon (Strength Bonus +2). For each +SL, you may choose one more Trait.

name: Wildercall
description: You make a call to a specific species of beasts. The call conveys a simple message, for example "food here".

name: Ferment
description: Cast on any material that could normally be fermented or beneficially aged, this spell brings it to the peak of suitability for consumption. To create high quality version, you must pass an appropriate Trade Test as well.

name: Timbervault
description: You can deposit a small creature or an object (1 Enc) into the foliage of any tree. The target vanishes into another realm of existence. You can then later cast this spell again on any other tree of the same species to retrieve the object. Creatures cannot be retrieved. The object can have +1 Enc for each SL.

name: Track's Tale Told
description: Let's you track any creature in natural, rural environment. Make a  Track Test with +2SL Bonus. If succeeded, you can track any creature that has passed withing WP Bonus yards. The spell lasts as long as you are tracking one single set of tracks. You lose the trail when the creature enters urban environment or crosses an artificial road.

name: Cleansing Glow
description: Restores the object to its original pristine state. If cast on a living being, it restores its clothing and cleans it. Leaving creatures suffer 1 Wound for each Corruption point they posses.

name: Disgust
description: Make an object disgusting for any creature the Daemonic or Undead Traits, or anyone with 3 or more Corruption points. They need to pass an opposed Cool Test resisted by the observer's Intuition or be visibly repulsed.

name: Illuminate
description:
Makes a source of light much stronger than it normally is. If cast in a dark environment, on the first round, anyone without Arcane
Magic - Light Talent looking at the source has to pass a Challenging (+0) Initiative Test to close their eyes, or receive a Blinded Condition.

name: Stay Death's Hand
description: Can be cast of a living creature or one that has just died. For the duration of the spell the creature stays alive as long as they take no further damage. Stops damage from Bleeding Conditions.

name: Deathsight
description: The target can sense Shyish Wind of Magic and see spirits. If the have not been warned about the effects of the spell, they must make a Challenging (+0) Cool Test or gain one Broken Condition.

name: Preservation
description: Can target a large food container, vehicle, or building. Prevents the perishables form getting spoiled and other objects are protected from wear and tear and environmental damage.

name: Shadows of Splendour
description: Can target object of up to 70 Enc. This spell makes it look either immensely valuable or completely worthless. Anyone with  Second Sight Talent who inspects the object, must pass a Hard (-20) Intuition Test to detect it has been enchanted.

name: Cloak Activity
description: You can conceal your real action with a fake action. For example, you might look like you are reading a book while in reality you are putting it in your bag. This spell does not change your location or masks/create new sounds. People interacting with you make Challenging (+0) Intuition Test to realise that something unnatural is happening.

name: Pall of Darkness
description: You plunge the area in darkness. It's impossible to see through it and anything that steps out of it receives 3 Blinded Conditions.

name: Badwill
description: Create atmosphere of mistrust and hatred. Everyone in AoE suffers -10 to all Fellowship Tests and any Prejudice Psychology becomes Hatred instead.

name: Bonesetter
description: Reduce the healing time for a Broken Bone injury by 1d10 days, plus an additional 1d10 days for each +SL.

name: Cleanslate
description: Cleanses the target of most forms of harmful magic.

name: Fertilise
description: Ensure that the next harvest will be at least average regardless of circumstances. They usual pay for this is 1/20 of the yield.

name: Fetterfetch
description: Allows you to track an item that binds a ghost to the mortal realm. You need to make an extended Difficult (-10) Navigate Test to follow the trail, with each Test requiring an hour, and a total of between 5 and 15 SL being required to succeed.

name: Geistbane
description: Creates a spirit repelling mixture. Smearing in on an entrance bars spirits from entering unless they pass a Hard (-20) Willpower. When used on weapon, the weapon counts as magic for the purpose of harming ghosts and undead. If used against undead that can be damaged with normal weapons, this mixture gives the weapon Damaging Quality. The effect ends immediately if the weapon gets in contact with blood.

name: Kindle
description: Creates a fire that cannot be extinguished. This fire grants +20 to all Endurance Tests to resist cold weather. Spoiled or poisoned food cooked over this fire becomes safe to eat.

name: Onerion
description: Prepare a 1 + SL doses of powder. This powder has to be consumed (usually in a drink) by target(s) before the spell duration expires. It allows you yo control their dream next time they sleep.

name: Stout Spirit
description: Has to be cast on a container of strong alcohol. Anyone who consumes it, automatically passes the first Fear Test they need to take.

name: Trankraft
description: Must be cast on a bowl of broth. After consuming it, the target ignores all Fatigued Conditions gained by tiredness for the duration of the spell.

name: Woecharm
description:
Enchant a single item of jewellery. It brings bad luck to its wearer. The wearer receives -10 to all Gamble Tests, -10 to Tests to resist any
kind of harmful magic, and +20 on the severity rolls for all Critical Wounds.

name: Godspakt
description: Select a spirit. The  spirit will perform one task requested by you. It will demand something in return.

name: Banishment of Böl
description:
You make a creature with Daemonic or Undead Trait to lose interest in you. If the creature's WP is equal of higher than yours you must win Opposed Cool Test for the spell to work, otherwise it works automatically.
The creature chooses nearest viable target instead, but you might direct it to a specific target if you have present the creature with a memento of that person.

name: Bonesnapper
description: You take a stone from a crumbling structure. You can throw it as Rock or used as Improvised Weapon. If it inflicts at least one Wound, that target must pass a Difficult (-10) Endurance Test, or suffer a Broken Bone (Minor). The spell expires after inflicting one Broken Bone.

name: Congeal
description: Target loses 1 + SL Bleeding Conditions. For each one you may inflict a Fatigued Condition. If you do, the target must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain Unconscious Condition.

name: Curse of the Treacherous Tongue
description: Your target must make a Hard (-20) Cool Test. If they fail, you may choose the next words they will speak. You cannot force them to talk, but when they do chose to talk they will say what you want. The effect lasts for 1 sentence.

name: Fatethief
description: The target looses 1 Fortune point. They must make a Hard (-20) Endurance Test. If they fail, they cannot gain any new Fortune points until the spell’s duration has passed.

name: Lodestone
description: With a sample of target's blood (no older than 1 day) you can track them for the duration of the spell.

name: Mirrored Abyss
description:
Opens a portal in a mirror or similar reflective surface. The portal leads to a void. Anyone trapped there must pass Challenging (+0)
Endurance Test each day or vanish forever. A second casting of this spell may open the portal again to bring them back.

name: Outcast's Curse
description: For the curse to take effect the victim must fail a Challenging (+0) Willpower Test. If the do, everyone around them feel suspicious about them. The target suffers  -20 to Fellowship based Tests to interact with others. Anyone with Second Sight Talent will see a cloud of Dhar around the cursed target.

name: Pactbind
description: Agree to a pact with a willing target. From now on, both of you must adhere to the terms as best of your ability. Whoever breaks  terms suffers from the following effects until they make amends. Any loss of Wounds causes a Bleeding Condition. Any time the victim would gain a Fatigued Condition, they gain two instead. The victim must add 40 to the results of any Critical Wound severity test.

name: Painjar
description: If the target fail a Hard (-20) Cool Test, they must roll for a Critical Wound even though they do not take any damage. For the duration of the spell they feel all effects of the wound.

name: Wayward Path
description:
You walk a path and make it impossible for anyone
else to follow. For the duration of the spell, the path is incomprehensible to anyone else.

name: Nameless Summons
description: Summon a daemon. After successful casting, make a Challenging (+0) Cool Test, roll 1d10 and add both numbers. -5 or worse: A greater daemon's hand drags you into its realm. -4 to -0: A hostile Lesser Daemon or a powerful spirit. 0 to 4: A neutral Lesser Daemon or a powerful spirit. 5 to 9: A favourable Lesser Daemon or a powerful spirit. 10 or better: A Greater Daemon with an interest in speaking with you.

name: Bilebrew
description: The Butcher and all friendly Ogres in AoE gain Hatred against a target (or group of targets) the Butcher chose.

name: Bloodgruel
description: Make an Easy (+40) Endurance Test. You heal 1 + SL Wounds. If you fail the Test, gain Bloody Flux.

name: Get Some Guts
description: All Ogres in AoE ignore any Broken Conditions.

name: Toothcracker
description:
You must make a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test. If you fail, lose 1 tooth for every -1 SL. If you pass, you and all friendly Ogres in AoE gain +20 to Endurance
and Cool Tests, and + 1 AP to all Hit Locations.

name: 'Ard as Nails
description: The target gains Hatred towards all enemies, may ignore all negative effects of Conditions and Diseases, and gain +2 SL to any Toughness based Tests.

name: Brainbursta
description: Target gains Prone and Stunned Conditions. Also gains 1 Stunned Condition for every +1 SL. If they suffer more Stunned Conditions than their Toughness Bonus, they must pass an Average (+20) Cool Test or suffer Critical Hit to the head.

name: 'Ere We Go!
description: All Orc allies in the AoE gain +2 Advantage for all Melee Tests.

name: The Evil Sun
description: All targets in the AoE suffer 8+SL Damage every Round and must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or receive an Ablaze Condition every Round.

name: Foot of Gork
description: All targets in the AoE gain Prone Condition. They must make a Difficult (-10) Dodge Test. If they pass, they receive 4 Damage (ignores AP) to random hit location, otherwise they receive 8 Damage.

name: Gaze of Mork
description: Any living creature on a straight line in the direction of the blast is hit by a Damage +4 magic missile. It also damages buildings with 65 or less Toughness.

name: The Hand of Gork
description: A giant hand scoops 1d10 targets (must be within Willpower Bonus yards of each other) and puts them down somewhere within range. The targets gain +1 Advantage.

name: Mork Save Us!
description: Target Orc, Hobgoblin, or Goblin gains Ward 10 Creature Trait. If they already have a Ward Trait, it improves by 1. It cannot be improved to 7 or better in this way.

name: WAAAGH!
target: AoE (Willpower yards) all Orcs, Hobgoblins, and Goblins within range
description: All targets in the AoE t gain 1 Advantage for specific use on Melee and Ranged Tests. It also removes any Broken Conditions and gives +2 SL to Cool and Endurance Tests.

name: Behave!
description:
Any accompanying Squig, Giant Wolf, Spider, or Snotling will follow the Shaman’s
commands with the discipline of a well-trained dog.

name: Curse of Da Bad Moon
description: Enemies in the AoE cannot use their Fortune Points and gain 1 Fatigued Condition.

name: Gift of the Spider-God
target: Forest Goblins in AoE (Willpower Bonus yards)
description: All allies in the AoE gain Venom Trait with  Challenging (+0) potency. If they already have the Venom Trait, it becomes Difficult (-10) potency.

name: Gork'll Fix It - v2
description: The targets gains 1 Fatigued Condition.

name: The Great Green Spite
description: Whenever a friendly Goblin (or Hobgoblin if the Shaman is a Hobgoblin)  in the AoE successfully hits an enemy, it counts as a Critical Hit.

name: Itchy Nuisance - v2
description: Target suffers a -1 SL to all Test. If they are wearing metal armour, the penalty is increased to -2 SL.

name: Mork Wants Ya!
description: A giant hand tries to lift the target. The target must win an Opposed Strength Test against a Strength of 80. If they lose, they suffer 10 Damage to the body location and then dropped from 2d10 yards.

name: Nikkit!
description: The Shaman conjures pair of hands that can pickpocket with Sleight of Hand skill of 55. On successful theft, the target may make a Challenging (+0) Perception to see the hands and that they are flying back to the Shaman.

name: Sneaky Stabbin' - v3
target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Orcs and Goblins
description: All hits made targets in the AoE gain Impale and Penetrating Qualities.

name: Vindictive Glare - v2
description: All enemies in the AoE are hit with magic missile with Damage +4. Anyone who takes damage, has to make a Challenging (+0) Cool Test or gain Stunned Condition.

name: Coruscation of Finreir
description: Rise on Light: Gain Flight (Agility) Creature Trait and 5 Armour Points on all Hit Locations. This magical barrier doesn't stack with worn Armour; use the higher value for each Hit Location. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Curse of Arrow Attraction
description: Warp Air: Shooters can reroll missed missile attacks against affected targets. Applies to magical ammunition and war machines, but not magic missiles. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Deadlock
description: Nullifies enemy spellcasting by creating a droning resonance of anti-magic. Target's spells are temporarily negated while weapons and armor function normally. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Fiery Convocation
description: Summons barrage of fire hitting all creatures in Area of Effect. Magic missile hit with Damage +5 and inflicts Ablaze Condition, which causes damage and Ablaze condition each round. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Drain Magic
description: Expels magic from the world by conjuring an aethyric vortex. Persistent spells in Area of Effect are immediately dispelled and accumulated magic is lost. Magic items and Hard Creature Traits unaffected. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Fortune is Fickle
description: Summons invisible spirits to distract a spellcaster. Doubles rolled on Channelling or Casting Tests cause a Miscast regardless of talents or ingredients. Casting Tests cannot cause Criticals and Dispelling fails on if they roll  doubles. Characters with Second Sight can perceive the spirits. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Glamour of Teclis
description: Conjures illusory maze of mist and shadows. Targets must pass Very Hard (-30) Navigation Test or wander randomly. If a target fails 3 Tests and you pass an Average (+20) Leadership Test, you may control directions of targets. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Hand of Glory
description: Invokes legendary Elven heroes to guide allies. Targets temporarily gain 3d10 to Weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill, Strength, Toughness, Initiative, or Agility, or Movement increased by 2. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Greater Banishment
description: Radiates streams of pure Qhaysh to banish evil. Daemonic and Undead creatures suffer magic missile damage +8 (or +15 for Size Large). Creatures with Undead trait suffer double damage. Destroyed Daemons cannot return for 1,001 days. Destroyed Undead can never be resummoned. Additionally, you can make a free Dispelling attempt against every Witchcraft, Daemonology, Necromancy, Dark Magic, or Chaos spell within the Area of Effect Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Invisible Eye
description: Creates an invisible floating eyeball that moves at command. Has Perception, Magick language talent, Sight, and Flight 120 trait. Can be destroyed if detected (3 Wounds). If destroyed, caster suffers from Surprised condition. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Shield of Saphery
description: Summons glittering protective field around allies. Friendly targets gain the Ward 9+ Creature Trait. Each High Magic spell improves the Ward trait by 1. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Soul Quench
description: Casts streaking lines of white light at foes, banishing souls to afterlife. Deals magic missile damage +6. Slain targets cannot manifest as ghosts or have souls bound into vessels. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Tempest
description: Summons polychromatic storm of crackling energy. Moves like random vortex spell (see Winds of Magic p .21) but skips steps 1-2. Creatures in Area of Effect suffer magic missile damage +4 and must pass Average Athletics Test. Flying targets suffer damage +5 and penalties to tests. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Walk between Worlds
description: Opens paths between worlds for allies. Friendly targets gain the Ethereal Creature Trait and doubled Movement scores. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Vaul's Grace
description: Enhances craftsmanship abilities, making weapons and armor more elegant and less cumbersome. When cast on non-magical weapons or armor being crafted, the item gains the Lightweight quality. A Trade (Smith) Test determines other qualities or flaws.

name: Vaul's Rage
description: Transforms forge energy into a massive explosion that leaves the caster unharmed. Everyone within Willpower Bonus yards takes fire damage in a random Hit Location with Damage +6, ignoring Armor, and receives 2 Ablaze conditions. Requires a Dodge Test or gain a Stunned condition. Everyone within 2 x Willpower Bonus yards suffers a Damage +3 hit and receives 1 Ablaze Condition.

name: Divination of Flames
description: Allows detection of approaching enemies and creatures within Intelligence Bonus yards of a targeted forge or campfire. Targets can be sensed even when hidden, regardless of line of sight or distance from the forge. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Artist's Touch
description: Enhances the aesthetic quality of crafted objects. When cast on a non-magical item being crafted, it gives the item Fine Quality. Other qualities or flaws may still be present alongside this enhancement.

name: Patience of Vaul
description: Compresses hours of artisanal patience into seconds. When cast on non-magical items being crafted, the SL required for Extended Tests is reduced to a quarter with no impact on the quality of the finished product.

name: Divination of Stones
description: Enables detection of rare minerals needed for magic item creation within a GM-determined range. Helps identify correct locations to dig and generally provides enough materials for items worth about 1d10 Encumbrance of magic items. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Fires of Perfection
description: Invokes Vaul's perfectionism to create flawless magical items. When cast on magical items being crafted, any Flaws, Quirks, or Curses rolled during the crafting process are ignored. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Wisdom of the Skysteel
description: Harnesses ancient crafting techniques to create exceptional items. You can make ithilmar item using a Crafting Endeavour. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Fortress of Hotek
description: Creates a forge chamber with multiple magical defenses. The area receives protective enchantments including a Firewall spell, magical armor protection (Glittering Robe spell), cursed walls that melt objects (Crucible of Chamon spell), and reinforced doors equivalent to gates that can only be damaged by siege weapons. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Fishbonding
description: Creates a magical bond with a non-magical, non-predatory fish. The creature becomes friendly. Hostile creatures become neutral while neutral creatures become friendly and will protect you if possible.

name: Stormsense
description: Grants knowledge about all nearby storms including direction, speed, intensity, whether gathering or subsiding, and duration. Also reveals if a storm has magical properties.

name: Ocean's Fury
description: Summons a powerful storm in the region that builds in intensity over time. The storm progresses through three stages: Near Gale, Strong Gale, and Violent Storm. This non-magical storm cannot be dispelled.

name: Spirits of the Waves
description: Conjures a powerful wind elemental from ocean currents manifesting as a swirling cyclone propelled by water spirits. The elemental can be controlled to move at high speed while concentrating, otherwise it moves as random vortex spell.

name: Armour of Mathlann
description: Envelops a single-masted ship with protective magic, providing Armour 2 Trait that doesn't add weight penalties. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Call of the Seas
description: Summons a Merwyrm monster that emerges from the sea. The creature is non-magical and neutral for of casting Fishbonding purposes. The caster does not control it. It returns to the depths when the spell expires. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Cloak of Mathlann
description: Conceals a single-masted ship within a dense cloak of sea fog, imposing –3 SL penalty on any attempt to see it. Ships leave a wake that might be noticed with Challenging (+0) Perception Test. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Waterlungs
description: Enables a target to breathe underwater. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Mistress of the Deep
description: Summons one of Mathlann's watery maidens to distract foes. Every Round, characters within 20 yards, must pass a Difficult (-10) Cool Test or become beguiled, rendering them Helpless except to move toward the Oceanid. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Writhing Mists
description: Creates a salt-scented mist that conceals allies, imposing –20 penalty to ranged attacks against friendly targets and gives +20 bonus to Stealth Tests. The mist disperses if concentration is broken. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Divine Stylus
description: Transforms your fingertip into a light-emitting writing tool. Allows inscription in any known language onto solid surfaces or suspended in air. Cannot create images, only text. The glowing script produces light comparable to a candle and remains visible for a duration equal to your Willpower Bonus in hours.

name: Enlightenment
description: Grants an animal temporary intellectual enhancement, boosting its Intelligence and Willpower by +20 while removing its Bestial and Skittish Traits. The enhanced creature gains capacity for complex communication and understanding.

name: Arcane Insight
description: Reveals the magical attributes, functions, curses, and bound entities within an enchanted object. Successfully passing a Challenging (+0) Intelligence Test unveils the item's creation method. Additional Success Levels provide information about its creator. For exceptionally powerful artifacts, complete understanding sufficient for replication may necessitate multiple castings via an Extended Intelligence Test.

name: Greater Spirit Bond
description: Extends the effective range of your Animal Telepathy and Companion Traits with your Animal Familiar the standard 4-yard limit to Willpower miles. Familiars cannot assist spellcasting through a long-range bond.

name: Crucible of Light
description: Channels the mystical essence of Hoeth into a blade. It counts as Magical and gains the Fast Quality. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Mnemonic Control
description: Accesses dormant memories within the target's subconsciousness. Guarantees automatic success on their next Lore or non-magical Language Test with bonus Success Levels equal to your Casting Test result. Requires plausible prior exposure to the knowledge being recalled. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Psychic Sending
description: Projects your thoughts as an audible message across vast distances. Functions only with recipients you've previously encountered or exchanged correspondence with. Transmissions may last up to one minute and are perceived in your natural speaking voice. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Sacred Wards
description: Establishes mystical barriers with one of four possible effects: Forgetfulness (erases recent memories), Purity (inflicts (Mutations × 6) Damage that ignores armor and Toughness Bonus while repelling Daemons), Surveillance (allows remote viewing within the warded area by concentrating for one Round), or Truthfulness (prevents falsehoods within the area). Only one warding per location is possible, though it can be maintained with a CN 0 Casting Test before expiration. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Soulcraft
description: Captures and anchors a Ghost's essence into a waystone or leyline. Both the spirit and its intended vessel must be within the spell's range. Recently deceased individuals (within the last hour) can have their spirits preserved before departing to the afterlife. Unwilling spirits may resist by making a Cool Test, with each Success Level increasing the spell's Casting Number by 1 for every SL it scores.

name: The Primary Words
description: Channels the primordial language predating the Old Ones, enabling universal communication with all mortal beings and animals. Complex concepts require an Intelligence Test from either party. Bystanders perceive only incomprehensible sounds unless they know Anoqeyan and succeed on an Average (+20) Language (Magick) Test. Special overcasting rules apply.

name: Bless Arrow
description: Infuses a non-magical arrow with arcane energy. The enchanted arrow counts as magical and gains +1 to Damage.

name: Calm
description: Induces tranquility and mental peace in the target. Removes any Prejudice, Animosity, Fear, or Frenzy effects if you succeed on a Challenging (+0) Fellowship Test.

name: Greenfinger
description: Accelerates plant growth and vitality through your touch. Affected plants grow to their maximum size and productivity at their natural pace, even in poor growing conditions. Dead plants return to life within a day, restoring them to their previous living state.

name: Identify Disease
description: Channels diagnostic wisdom to identify ailments. The spell reveals the names and effects of any diseases affecting a person, plant, or animal within your touch range.

name: Remove Dirt
description: Causes dirt and grime to fall away from the touched target, leaving objects, people, or animals perfectly clean. When cast on a surface, cleans an area with radius equal to your Willpower Bonus yards.

name: Reveal Magic
description: Makes magical energies visible in your vicinity. Magical objects and creatures within range glow brightly enough to be seen, even if hidden.

name: Enchant Plant
description: Imbues a non-magical plant with a permanent magical property. Chose one: Hardy (resistant to poor lighting, dry soil, and adverse temperature conditions), Nourishing (fruits, nuts, roots, or leaves weigh half the normal Encumbrance to satisfy food requirements), and Vessel (a Lesser Daemon, Minor Elemental, or soul can be bound into the plant as if it was a Power Stone).

name: Lesser Banishment
description: Banishes a Ghost, Spectre, Lesser Daemon, or Daemonic Beast. If you win an Opposed Willpower/Cool Test, the target is sent back to the spirit-realm or Realm of Chaos from which it originated.

name: Magic Alarm
description: Designate monitoring area. Become aware of any creature or spirit Size Tiny or larger enters the alarmed area. If you are sleeping, it wakes you up.

name: Masking the Mind
description: Conceal your thoughts and emotions. Intuition and mind-reading or scrying spell Tests against you are Very Hard (-30).

name: Purify Body
description: After passing a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test, you can cure the target of one disease or extract one poison. If you Fumble the Test, you contract the disease or poison yourself.

name: Speak with Animal
description: You communicate with an animal. Characters who know Anoqeyin can attempt an Average (+20) Language (Magick) Test to understand the exchange. While the spell is active, you can use Charm Skill on the target animal (instead of Charm Animal Skill).

name: Voice of Iron
description: Your words magically command attention and respect. Normal or shouted speech carries for triple its natural range and provides a +10 bonus to Intimidation and Leadership Tests. The bonus is lost if listeners pass a Difficult (-10) Perception Test to notice the unnatural cadences in your voice.

name: Zone of Comfort
description: Shield yourself against insects and weather. Tiny and Little creatures with the Swarm Trait cannot attack you. You are immune to the effects of Cold and Heat Exposure and receive 1 Damage less from cold-based and heat-based attacks.
